evidence_for: M15 bear spike is real: bar 1790172000000 (open 2714.8, high 2722.14, low 2667.17, close 2670.58) and bar 1790172900000 (open 2670.51, high 2670.58, low 2648.49, close 2652.42) both closed within about 4 points of their lows.

The following 13 M15 bars, 1790173800000 through 1790185500000, all overlap the prior bar and stay inside the 2641.37 low (bar 1790179200000) to 2681.07 high (bar 1790175600000); the final close 2665.44 (bar 1790185500000) is roughly 4 points from the 2661.22 midpoint, i.e., mid-range rather than at an edge.

No M15 close outside 2641.37-2681.07 and no breakout bar with follow-through in either direction, so no trigger is present at the frozen decision time (last bar 1790185500000 range is only 2664.02-2668.02).

Higher timeframes conflict: H4 bar 1790164800000 closed 2659 below the 2716.01 twelve-bar range low and at the bull spike low 2658.06 (H4 always-in short), while D1 context remains always-in long in a breakout-spike above 2775.61 with swing lows 2357.18/2358.62 intact; neither gives a directional edge at 2665.

Location punishes both sides: the nearest opposing structure above is the 2681.07 range high and the nearest support is 2641.37, so any entry near 2665 sits between them with no nearby invalidation that is both tight and structural.
evidence_against: Strongest counterargument (short): H4 broke a tight twelve-bar range with a bear trend bar closing 10.51 above its low, and M15 then printed a marginal new low 2641.37 under the H4 swing low 2648.49 followed by eight overlapping bars, which is textbook bear-flag behaviour; a pending sell stop below 2641.37 with invalidation above 2681.07 is a coherent continuation trade, so the missing trigger is pending rather than failed.

Strongest counterargument (long): D1 is always-in long in a breakout-spike, the H4 pullback from 2850 holds above the 2609.02 base-range top and the 2568.16 leg origin, and the last two H1 bars made higher lows (2641.37 then 2649.16) with bar 1790182800000 closing 2665.44 near its high, which supports a buy stop above the last M15 high 2668.02.
uncertainty: Whether the 13-bar M15 overlap resolves as a bear flag (second leg down) or a bull reversal base is undetermined by the frozen bars.
D1 always-in long conflicts with H4 always-in short at low relevance, so the higher-timeframe lean is not directive; the H4 read is itself described as phase 'range'.
The M15 low 2641.37 undercut the H4 swing low 2648.49 by only 7 points, so the H4 bear breakout has not been decisively confirmed.
The two most recent M15 bars are small bull bars inside the range, and an inside/mid-range bar cannot be graded as a signal bar.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 close above 2681.07 (high of bar 1790175600000) that holds would mark a failed bear breakout and make a long above that level the actionable setup.
An M15 close below 2641.37 (low of bar 1790179200000) with follow-through would confirm the bear flag and validate a short on that breakout.
A close below 2609.02 (H4 base-range top) would shift the H4 read to bearish; a close back above 2716.01 would restore the H4 range/bull read.
Continued overlap inside 2641.37-2681.07 keeps price mid-range and keeps this a no-trade location.

evidence_for: M15 index 119 (open_time_ms 1790214300000, close_time_ms 1790215199999, open 2678.83, high 2679.26, low 2673.74, close 2673.99) closes in the lower quarter of its range: no bull signal bar exists at the frozen time, so the long side has no trigger.

M15 index 118 (1790213400000-1790214299999, open 2682.01, high 2690.73, low 2678.83, close 2678.83) is a bear bar closing at its low and its 2690.73 high is a lower high versus 2695.84 (M15 index 104, 1790200800000-1790201699999, high 2695.84, close 2690.39), so immediate momentum is down, not up.

The M15 bear break is marginal and unaccepted: index 119 low 2673.74 is only 1.99 below the 15-bar floor 2675.73 (M15 index 104 low) and index 119 closed 2673.99 back above that floor, with no follow-through bar in the supplied data (indices 104-117 overlap between 2675.73 and 2695.84).

Short location is crowded by opposing structure: the nearest M15/H1 support below is the 2641.37 higher low (M15 index 80 low, H1 index 110 low, both 2641.37), while supplied H4 context is bull-trend/channel with that higher low intact and D1 is also bull-trend, so the room to support (~32.6) is barely more than the ~16.99 distance from a 2673.74 sell stop to a 2690.73 invalidation.

H1 index 119 (1790211600000-1790215199999, open 2681.89, high 2690.73, low 2673.74, close 2673.99) closes at its low but is the third bar of a pullback inside the H1 recovery from 2641.37 (index 110) to 2695.84 (index 116), leaving the H1 read two-sided rather than a defined breakdown.
evidence_against: Strongest case for a short: M15 indices 118-119 are consecutive bear bars (closes 2678.83 at the low, then 2673.99 near the low) breaking the 2675.73-2695.84 range with a lower high 2690.73 under 2695.84 - a Brooks trading-range bear breakout; a stop below 2673.74 with invalidation above 2690.73 still offers roughly 1.9:1 to the 2641.37 support.

H1 confirms short-term pressure: index 119 broke the 2680.41 low of H1 index 117 and closed at its low, with H1 lows 2680.41/2679.08/2673.74 successively lower while highs stay capped near 2690.4-2690.7.

Supplied H4/D1 contexts retain a bearish tail: H4 lower high 2804.59 versus the 2850 window high, H4 bar 117 closing 2659 below the 2716.01 shelf with 2684.16 still below that shelf, the 15-bar pullback retracing about 74% of 2568.16-2850 (increasingly range-like), and D1 bar 119 closing 2684.16 in the lower part of its 2641.37-2786.81 range.

Strongest case for a long: the M15 15-bar range could be a bull flag, its shallow break above the intact H4 higher low 2641.37 (H4 context: responsive bulls, bar-118 reversal bar) would be a bear trap, and a buy above 2690.73 would target 2695.84/2716.01 - but no bull signal bar or bull close exists in the supplied bars to justify it.
uncertainty: The M15 2675.73-2695.84 range may be a bull flag whose downside break is a bear trap rather than a top, so the break has no accepted status and is not a failed setup either.
Supplied H4 and D1 contexts are computed at 1790207999999 (bar closing 2684.16) and exclude the latest hour: H1 indices 118-119 and M15 indices 112-119 down to 2673.99 appear only in raw H1/M15 bars.

The bearish trigger (break of 2673.74) is only 0.25 below the frozen close 2673.99 while the bullish side has no signal bar, so neither direction offers an untriggered pending entry with both acceptable location and defensible invalidation.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 close back above 2690.73 (M15 index 118 high, 1790213400000-1790214299999) would negate the range break and support the bull-flag/bear-trap read for a long.
Two consecutive M15 closes below 2673.74 with follow-through would confirm the range breakout and shift the read toward 2655 (measured move) and 2641.37.
A close below 2641.37 (M15 index 80 low / H1 index 110 low) would break the H4 higher-low sequence and shift the read from bull-trend pullback to bear leg or trading range.
Acceptance above 2695.84 (M15 index 104 high) and then 2716.01 would restore H4 bull continuation and make the current dip a completed pullback.

evidence_for: Location: the decision price 2684.74 is only about 6 below repeatedly tested resistance - M15 index 114 (open_time 1790213400000, high 2690.73) and index 117 (open_time 1790216100000, high 2690.73) form a double top, with the 2695.84 high of index 100 (open_time 1790200800000) immediately above.

Trader's equation: the nearest structural invalidation is the M15 index 116 low 2666.2 (open_time 1790215200000), about 18.5 below price, while the first resistance shelf is about 6 above, so nearby opposing structure crowds the setup relative to its invalidation.

evidence_against: Strongest long case - a completed bear trap with follow-through: M15 index 116 (open 2673.99, low 2666.2) broke below the 2678-2680 lows, then index 117 (open 2670, high 2690.73, close 2679.36) reversed back above that shelf and indices 118-119 closed 2684.49 and 2684.74.

uncertainty: Whether the H4 2641.37 low is the floor of a bull flag that holds the 2568.16 higher low or the first shoulder of an unconfirmed MTR top from 2850; H4 stays bull-trend/channel with limited always-in relevance.
Whether the M15 2666.2 low is a completed higher low or a pause inside the pullback from 2695.84.

A close below 2666.2 (M15 index 116 low) with follow-through would break the M15 higher low and open a move toward 2641.37 (H1 index 109 low), supporting a short.
A close below 2641.37 would confirm the H4 pullback break and shift the read from channel/bull-trend to trading range/transition.
Continued overlapping bars between 2666.2 and 2690.73 keep the decision price mid-range with no edge.

market_context.regime_detail: M15 bars 96-119 (open_time 1790200800000-1790221500000) are a 24-bar tight trading range: the 2695.84 high of bar 96 was never exceeded and the low is 2666.2 (bar 112); H1 bars 116-119 are four small overlapping bars closing 2688.8, 2684.16, 2681.47, 2675.48, i.e. no always-in side.
market_context.location: Close 2675.48 (M15 bar 119) sits mid-structure between the 2641.37 pullback low (M15 bar 72) about 34 points below and the broken H4 2716.01 shelf about 40 points above; the 2690-2696 cluster (M15 highs of bars 96, 97, 99, 106, 110, 113) is immediate overhead resistance.
market_context.h4_read: Supplied H4 context is stale; a successful raw read of 120 closed 4h bars was made. H4 bar 104 spiked to 2850 and closed 2723.15 in the lower third of its range; bar 117 closed 2659 below the 2716.01 shelf and bar 118 undercut to 2641.37 and reversed (close 2676.47). Bull trend intact but a deep 74% retracement, unconfirmed mtr-like top, price still below the broken shelf.
market_context.d1_context: D1 context is current: bull-trend/channel with higher lows, but bars 118-119 are two consecutive bear bars with bar 119 closing 2684.16 in the lower part of its range from the 2850 high.
market_context.always_in: unclear on M15/H1 (two-sided tight range); D1/H4 lean long but location is unresolved.

evidence_for: M15 bars 96-119 are a tight, overlapping 24-bar range: high 2695.84 (bar 96, open_time 1790200800000) was never taken out (next-highest highs 2693.33 bar 97, 2691.93 bar 99, 2690.73 bars 110/113) and the range low is 2666.2 (bar 112, open_time 1790215200000); closes stay between 2666 and 2691 - a tight trading range where Brooks expects most breakouts to fail.

The last M15 bar 119 (open_time 1790221500000, o 2674.87, h 2675.66, l 2672.3, c 2675.48, range 3.36) is an inside doji in the middle of that range, not a signal bar at a range edge, so no trigger is live in either direction.

A long trigger above 2695.84 would enter directly into the 2690-2696 M15 high cluster and the broken H4 2716.01 shelf roughly 20 points higher, so nearby opposing structure crowds the setup relative to any structural invalidation below 2666.2.

A short trigger below 2666.2 has the 2641.37 higher low (M15 bar 72, open_time 1790179200000, low 2641.37) only about 25 points away and the mid-range position gives no measured room, so the bear case is equally crowded.

M15 bar 96's bull spike (o 2676.41, h 2695.84, c 2690.39) got no follow-through: bar 97 closed 2686.34 back below it and bars 100-119 stayed below its high, so that breakout attempt is stale rather than actionable.

H1 bars 116-119 (open_time 1790200800000-1790218800000) are four small overlapping bars (ranges about 8-20 points) closing 2688.8/2684.16/2681.47/2675.48 with the last H1 bar 119 closing 2675.48 in the lower half of its 2670.72-2688.88 range - no H1 always-in side and no H1 breakout follow-through.
evidence_against: Higher-timeframe bull structure: the M15/H4 pullback low 2641.37 (M15 bar 72) is a higher low versus 2568.16 (H4 bar 98) and the 2358.62 base low (H4 bar 70), and H4 bars 87-88 broke out above 2519.81 without ever trading back into the base - a bull could treat the M15 range as a bull flag above that higher low.

Responsive buying at the low is visible: M15 bar 72 printed low 2641.37 and closed 2662.39 near its high, and bars 112-113 reversed up from 2666.2 to close 2679.36 near the 2690.73 high, so bulls are defending the pullback area.
D1 context is current and still bull-trend/channel with higher lows (2357.18 bar 99, 2358.62 bar 111), so a breakout above 2695.84 would be with, not against, the larger trend.
uncertainty: Whether the 24-bar M15 tight range resolves upward as a bull flag continuation or downward as an mtr-like top from the 2804.59/2850 highs is undetermined at decision_time_ms; the H4 context describing that top is stale and was replaced by a raw 4h read.
Depth of the H4 pullback (about 74% of the 2568.16-2850 leg) makes both 'deep bull pullback' and 'trend-ending reversal' plausible descriptions of the same bars.
conditions_that_change_market_read: A close above 2695.84 (M15 bar 96 high) that holds on the next bar would create a breakout-pullback long candidate, though the 2716.01 H4 shelf would still cap location.
A close below 2666.2 (M15 bar 112 low) followed by acceptance below 2641.37 (M15 bar 72 low) would break the higher-low sequence and support an mtr-like short.
Continued overlapping M15 bars between 2666.2 and 2695.84 keeps the read as a mid-range tight trading range with no edge in either direction.

evidence_for: M15 bars 96-119 are a tight, overlapping 24-bar range: high 2695.84 (bar 96, open_time 1790200800000) was never taken out (next-highest highs 2693.33 bar 97, 2691.93 bar 99, 2690.73 bars 110/113) and the range low is 2666.2 (bar 112, open_time 1790215200000); closes stay between 2666 and 2691 - a tight trading range where Brooks expects most breakouts to fail.

The last M15 bar 119 (open_time 1790221500000, o 2674.87, h 2675.66, l 2672.3, c 2675.48, range 3.36) is an inside doji in the middle of that range, not a signal bar at a range edge, so no trigger is live in either direction.

A long trigger above 2695.84 would enter directly into the 2690-2696 M15 high cluster and the broken H4 2716.01 shelf roughly 20 points higher, so nearby opposing structure crowds the setup relative to any structural invalidation below 2666.2.

A short trigger below 2666.2 has the 2641.37 higher low (M15 bar 72, open_time 1790179200000, low 2641.37) only about 25 points away and the mid-range position gives no measured room, so the bear case is equally crowded.

M15 bar 96's bull spike (o 2676.41, h 2695.84, c 2690.39) got no follow-through: bar 97 closed 2686.34 back below it and bars 100-119 stayed below its high, so that breakout attempt is stale rather than actionable.

H1 bars 116-119 (open_time 1790200800000-1790218800000) are four small overlapping bars (ranges about 8-20 points) closing 2688.8/2684.16/2681.47/2675.48 with the last H1 bar 119 closing 2675.48 in the lower half of its 2670.72-2688.88 range - no H1 always-in side and no H1 breakout follow-through.
evidence_against: Higher-timeframe bull structure: the M15/H4 pullback low 2641.37 (M15 bar 72) is a higher low versus 2568.16 (H4 bar 98) and the 2358.62 base low (H4 bar 70), and H4 bars 87-88 broke out above 2519.81 without ever trading back into the base - a bull could treat the M15 range as a bull flag above that higher low.

Responsive buying at the low is visible: M15 bar 72 printed low 2641.37 and closed 2662.39 near its high, and bars 112-113 reversed up from 2666.2 to close 2679.36 near the 2690.73 high, so bulls are defending the pullback area.
D1 context is current and still bull-trend/channel with higher lows (2357.18 bar 99, 2358.62 bar 111), so a breakout above 2695.84 would be with, not against, the larger trend.
uncertainty: Whether the 24-bar M15 tight range resolves upward as a bull flag continuation or downward as an mtr-like top from the 2804.59/2850 highs is undetermined at decision_time_ms; the H4 context describing that top is stale and was replaced by a raw 4h read.
Depth of the H4 pullback (about 74% of the 2568.16-2850 leg) makes both 'deep bull pullback' and 'trend-ending reversal' plausible descriptions of the same bars.
conditions_that_change_market_read: A close above 2695.84 (M15 bar 96 high) that holds on the next bar would create a breakout-pullback long candidate, though the 2716.01 H4 shelf would still cap location.
A close below 2666.2 (M15 bar 112 low) followed by acceptance below 2641.37 (M15 bar 72 low) would break the higher-low sequence and support an mtr-like short.
Continued overlapping M15 bars between 2666.2 and 2695.84 keeps the read as a mid-range tight trading range with no edge in either direction.

market_context.location: H1 bar 119 close 2683.04 sits above the pullback low 2641.37 but below the broken 2716.01 swing low and below the H4 lower high 2786.81; the M15 micro range in-window is 2641.37-2697.41

evidence_for: Location is mid-structure, not at an edge: H4 context (freshness current) describes a pullback range 2641.37-2786.81 with lower highs 2804.59, 2786.81, 2748.23, 2695.84, and H1 bar 119 (open 2681.55, high 2697.41, low 2680.7, close 2683.04) closed in the lower-middle of that range, so neither the range-top short nor a range-low long has favorable location.

The top of the M15 micro range was rejected, not defended: M15 bar 116 (open_time 1790226000000, open 2681.55, high 2697.41, close 2690.96) made the micro high, and the following and last closed M15 bar 119 (open_time 1790228700000, open 2690.6, high 2690.6, low 2682.71, close 2683.04) is a bear bar closing at its low, so there is no bull signal bar at the entry location.

The M15 advance is a grinding channel, not a spike: from the 2641.37 low (M15 bar 64, open_time 1790179200000, low 2641.37) to 2697.41 (M15 bar 116) spans roughly 52 bars of small overlapping bodies (e.g., M15 bars 88-99 with closes 2690.39, 2686.34, 2682.31, 2688.8, 2685.03, 2682.8, 2680.89, 2684.16, 2684.75, 2687.5, 2684.6, 2681.47), so buying the upper end of that channel is poor location.

Trader's Equation is crowded for the long: the nearest opposing level 2716.01 (H1 bar 71, open_time 1790053200000, low 2716.01) is only about 19 points above a bull stop at 2697.42 (M15 bar 116 high 2697.41), while the nearest higher-low invalidation 2666.2 (M15 bar 104, open_time 1790215200000, low 2666.2) is about 31 points below.

No short trigger exists either: no closed H1 or M15 bar trades below the pullback low 2641.37 (M15 bar 64 low 2641.37; H1 bar 106, open_time 1790179200000, low 2641.37) or below the 2666.2 higher low (M15 bar 104 low 2666.2; H1 bar 116, open_time 1790215200000, low 2666.2), so a short would be counter to the D1 always_in long with no breakdown.
evidence_against: D1 context (freshness current) is bull-trend/channel with always_in long and higher swing lows 2111, 2357.18, 2358.62, 2435.72, so a long is the with-trend direction.

H4 context: the pullback low 2641.37 (H4 bar 1790179200000, low 2641.37, close 2676.47) holds above the prior higher low 2568.16 and above the 50% level 2604.31 of the 2358.62-2850 leg, the classic shallow bull-flag position, and a bull stop above M15 bar 116 high 2697.41 would be a continuation entry consistent with that read.

Immediate H1 pressure is not one-way bearish: after the pullback low the H1 lows are 2648.49 (bar 104), 2641.37 (bar 106), then 2649.67/2649.16 and M15 bar 104 low 2666.2, and the last H1 bar 119 traded up to 2697.41, so buyers are still stepping in above the H4 breakout base.
uncertainty: The 120-bar M15 window starts at 1790121600000 in the 2749-2786 zone and does not contain the 2786.81 lower high that defines the H4 pullback, so edge classification mixes an M15 micro range (2641.37-2697.41) with H4 range boundaries (2641.37-2786.81).

Both cases hinge on the same unresolved 17-point range, so neither counterargument supplies a triggered, follow-through-confirmed entry at 1790251199999; taking either direction here is a coin-flip breakout attempt inside a tight range rather than a Brooks edge.

D1.note: Raw D1 context is bull-trend/channel with Always-In long, but flags an unconfirmed two-bar bear reversal (bar 117 high 2850, bars 118-119 down).

H4.note: H4 context describes six bars holding below the broken 2716.01 range low with no bull reversal bar, while the higher-low chain from 2358.62 (last link 2633.31) is still intact.

market_context.location: M15 close 2668.42 (index 119) is mid-way between the 2633.31 pullback low (index 106) and H1 swing highs 2693.42 (H1 index 114) / 2698.06 (H1 index 113), all of it below the broken 2716.01 H4 range low.

evidence_for: M15 index 119 (open_time 1790257500000, close_time 1790258399999) closes 2668.42 at its high with low 2660.03 after four higher-closing bull bars; this is the fifth consecutive bull bar up from the 2633.31 low (M15 index 106, low 2633.31, close 2642.59), so the actionable reversal trigger (above the 2647.83 high of H1 index 116 / the 2642.60 close-high of M15 index 106) already fired about 21-26 points lower. A fresh long at 2668.42 is late in the leg, not at the reversal.

Location is mid-band, not an edge: the 2633.31 pullback low (M15 index 106) is only marginally below the prior M15 low 2641.37 (index 32, low 2641.37), and 2668.42 sits between that low and the H1 swing highs 2693.42 (H1 index 114 high) and 2698.06 (H1 index 113 high), below the H4-broken 2716.01 range low. In Brooks terms this is a two-sided range middle, where buying is not favored.

The immediate higher-timeframe read opposes a long: the current H4 context (decision_time_ms 1790251199999) is Always-In short with breakout_mode true, describing six consecutive bars below the broken 2716.01 range low with no bull reversal bar (H4 closes 2676.47, 2684.16, 2675.48, 2692.23 in the small flag under the break).

Opposing structure crowds the setup relative to any defensible stop: H1 index 119 high 2671.94 is only 3.5 points above the M15 close, H1 index 114 high 2693.42 and index 113 high 2698.06 sit 25-30 points up, versus an invalidation 2660.03 (8.4 points) or 2633.31 (35 points). The space between entry and resistance is thin.
evidence_against: Strongest counterargument: the D1 context is current bull-trend/channel with Always-In long, and the H4 higher-low chain from 2358.62 is still unbroken (2633.31 above the 2568.16 bull-flag low), so the 2786.81-to-2633.31 drop (153.50 points, about 54% of the 2568.16-2850 leg) reads as a bull pullback rather than a top, which normally favors buying.

M15 index 106 (open 2638.94, high 2642.60, low 2633.31, close 2642.59) is a failed break below the 2641.37 low (index 32): it made a marginal new low and closed at the top of its range, and every subsequent pullback low is higher (2640.00 index 114, 2640.48 index 115, 2647.53 index 116, 2655.46 index 117, 2659.48 index 118, 2660.03 index 119) with closes pressing the highs. That is a short-term bull micro-channel with follow-through, the classic Brooks buy pattern inside a bull trend.

The H4 context itself records buying at the lows (bars 1790179200000 close 2676.47, 1790193600000 close 2684.16, 1790222400000 close 2692.23 all closing in the upper halves) and its final bar 1790236800000 dipped to 2633.31 and closed back at 2647.90 above the 2645.88/2644.86 highs it undercut, i.e. a failed downside break, not a confirmed bear breakout.

No bear signal bar exists in the last five M15 bars (indices 115-119 all bull), so the bearish H4 read has no actionable trigger either; the decision is to abstain at the range middle, not to short the bull bars.
Whether the 2668.42 close-at-high starts a new leg or completes the M15 move off the 2633.31-2651.66 consolidation cannot be settled from closed bars at the frozen time.

evidence_for: M15 index 119 (open_time 1790257500000, close_time 1790258399999) closes 2668.42 at its high with low 2660.03 after four higher-closing bull bars; this is the fifth consecutive bull bar up from the 2633.31 low (M15 index 106, low 2633.31, close 2642.59), so the actionable reversal trigger (above the 2647.83 high of H1 index 116 / the 2642.60 close-high of M15 index 106) already fired about 21-26 points lower. A fresh long at 2668.42 is late in the leg, not at the reversal.

Location is mid-band, not an edge: the 2633.31 pullback low (M15 index 106) is only marginally below the prior M15 low 2641.37 (index 32, low 2641.37), and 2668.42 sits between that low and the H1 swing highs 2693.42 (H1 index 114 high) and 2698.06 (H1 index 113 high), below the H4-broken 2716.01 range low. In Brooks terms this is a two-sided range middle, where buying is not favored.

The immediate higher-timeframe read opposes a long: the current H4 context (decision_time_ms 1790251199999) is Always-In short with breakout_mode true, describing six consecutive bars below the broken 2716.01 range low with no bull reversal bar (H4 closes 2676.47, 2684.16, 2675.48, 2692.23 in the small flag under the break).

Opposing structure crowds the setup relative to any defensible stop: H1 index 119 high 2671.94 is only 3.5 points above the M15 close, H1 index 114 high 2693.42 and index 113 high 2698.06 sit 25-30 points up, versus an invalidation 2660.03 (8.4 points) or 2633.31 (35 points). The H4 context itself records buying at the lows (bars 1790179200000 close 2676.47, 1790193600000 close 2684.16, 1790222400000 close 2692.23 all closing in the upper halves) and its final bar 1790236800000 dipped to 2633.31 and closed back at 2647.90 above the 2645.88/2644.86 highs it undercut, i.e. a failed downside break, not a confirmed bear breakout.
uncertainty: Timeframe conflict is unresolved by the supplied closed bars: D1 current Always-In long vs H4 current Always-In short and breakout_mode true; the same 2633.31-2698.06 band can be read as a bull flag or as a lower-high reversal base, and I will not treat either analyst label as a vote.

No bear signal bar exists in the last five M15 bars (indices 115-119 all bull), so the bearish H4 read has no actionable trigger either; the decision is to abstain at the range middle, not to short the bull bars.
Whether the 2668.42 close-at-high starts a new leg or completes the M15 move off the 2633.31-2651.66 consolidation cannot be settled from closed bars at the frozen time.

evidence_for: M15 bars 109-119 (open_time 1790334900000 to 1790343900000) form a 12-bar overlapping range between high 2740.42 (bar 109) and low 2686.77 (bar 119), roughly 2% tall, i.e. a tight trading range where Brooks' guidance is to wait rather than enter mid-range.

No signal bar in either direction: M15 bar 119 (open 2700.89, high 2701.79, low 2686.77, close 2693.95) is a small bear body closing mid-range with 7.18 of lower tail and 7.84 of upper tail after bar 118 (open 2700.8, high 2707.75, low 2691.09, close 2700.89), a doji; there is no bull reversal bar to buy and no strong bear bar at a range high to sell.

The pullback has already given back about 50% of the bar-10 low 2633.31 to bar-109 high 2740.42 advance (2740.42 to 2686.77 = 53.65 points), which is trading-range behaviour rather than a shallow one-to-three-bar bull flag.

Price 2693.95 is back below the H4 10-bar range top 2699.53 (H4 bar 118) after H4 bar 120 (open 1790323200000) broke to 2740.42 with a 24.52 upper tail and closed 2715.90, so the H4 range is intact again with no accepted breakout; M15 bar 117 (open 2714.07, high 2717.75, low 2699.78, close 2700.8) closed 1.02 above its low at that ceiling.

A short from here would be countertrend against D1 (bars 114-117 closed 2612.02, 2632.98, 2642.90, 2775.61 above the 2557.46 range top) and against the intact H4 higher-low sequence 2358.62 -> 2568.16 -> 2633.31, and it would be taken at the low of the immediate M15 range rather than at a high.
evidence_against: Strongest counterargument to standing aside: the higher timeframes are still bull. H4 bar 120 (open 1790323200000, low 2671.18) broke the 2633.31-2699.53 ten-bar range to 2740.42 and closed 2715.90, its pullback low 2633.31 sits 65.15 above the prior swing low 2568.16, and D1 bar 120 closed 2686.59 in the upper 81% of its 66.08 range, 129 points above the 2557.46 breakout level, so a bull-flag breakout above 2740.42 with a stop below 2686.77 is the textbook continuation trade this read forecloses.

M15 trend structure is still up: higher lows 2667.22 (bar 94, open_time 1790321400000), 2671.18 (bar 96) and 2686.77 (bar 119 low) paired with higher highs 2693.77 (bar 101 high), 2710.61 (bar 103 high) and 2740.42 (bar 109 high); bar 108 (open 2712.86, high 2738.74, close 2738.74) closed on its high as a spike bar, and bar 113 (open 2716.21, high 2718.62, low 2688.28, close 2709.92) left a 21.64 lower tail, evidence that buyers are still defending dips above 2686.77.

The current bar-119 low 2686.77 has not been broken, so the pullback is not yet a failed breakout and the always-in on D1/H4 remains long; an aggressive bull could treat the last three overlapping bars at the 2699.53 level as a breakout pullback to the H4 range top and buy a stop above 2740.42 (M15 bar 109 high) with invalidation at 2686.77 (M15 bar 119 low).
uncertainty: Whether the 12-bar M15 range 2686.77-2740.42 is a bull flag that resolves up or the start of a deeper pullback toward 2648.49 / 2633.31 cannot be resolved from the closed bars; the 50% retracement makes it genuinely two-sided.

The H4 context ends at bar 120 (close 2715.90); the forming H4 bar built by M15 bars 112-119 already shows rejection below the 2699.53 ceiling, but its status as a failed break or a bull flag cannot be settled at this decision time.
The last M15 bar 119 has a small body with roughly symmetric tails (7.18 lower / 7.84 upper), so the immediate next-bar direction is genuinely unclear and any present-bar entry would be mid-range.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 bull bar closing above 2740.42 (bar 109 high) would confirm the bull flag breakout and make a long stop entry above that level the actionable continuation trade.
An M15 close below 2686.77 (bar 119 low) followed by a lower high below 2740.42 would mark the pullback as a failed breakout of the H4 range and shift the read toward a leg down to 2648.49 / 2633.31.
A strong bull reversal bar closing back above the H4 range top 2699.53 would restore a breakout-pullback long at that level rather than mid-range.
Continued small overlapping M15 closes between 2686.77 and 2740.42 keeps this a tight trading range where the edge is at the boundaries, not at 2693.95.

setup.type: bull-trend pullback into the top edge of a tight range; unconfirmed break of 2699.53 (candidate long only)

evidence_for: Location: any long trigger would sit under the range ceiling - M15 bar 118 high 2696.07 and bar 119 high 2695.31 are only 3.46-4.22 points below 2699.53 (M15 bar 69 high), the top of the H4 tight range 2633.31-2699.53; close 2694.47 is 92% of that 66.22-point range, i.e. buying the top edge, not an edge opportunity for longs.

The same ceiling already rejected price: H4 bar 120 (high 2740.42) closed 2715.90, a 24.52-point upper tail, and the three H1 bars after it closed 2717.13, 2693.95 and 2694.47, returning two closes inside the 2633.31-2699.53 range; the M15 breakout leg 2698.19 (bar 96 high) to 2740.42 (bar 105 high) was fully retraced to 2677.40 (bar 116 low).

Nearby opposing structure crowds any long relative to its invalidation: 2696.07 (M15 bar 118 high), 2699.53 (M15 bar 69 high), 2701.79 (bar 115 high), 2707.75 (bar 114 high), 2717.75 (bar 113 high) all sit within 4-22 points above bar 119's close, while the only tight invalidation is bar 119 low 2683.08 (12.23 points).

uncertainty: The coil is unresolved and could break either way; no closed bar yet shows a decisive escape.

setup.type: tight trading range / mid-band chop, no actionable setup

evidence_for: M15 bars 96-119 (1790373600000-1790394300000) form a tight trading range: highest high 2694.43 (M15 bar 110, 1790386200000) and lowest low 2678.85 (M15 bar 96, 1790373600000), a band under 16 points wide; the decision bar 119 (1790394300000, open 2687.24, high 2687.34, low 2686.61, close 2686.84, range 0.73) closes exactly mid-band with no breakout attempt.

H1 shows the same compression: bars 108-119 (1790352000000-1790391600000) overlap inside 2678 (H1 bar 113 low) to 2695.19 (H1 bar 110 high), roughly 0.6% wide, after the single spike to 2738.74 (H1 bar 103, 1790334000000); price is mid-range with no edge on either side.

No signal bar or trigger exists: the M15 bull bar 112 (1790388000000, open 2691.30, high 2694.24, low 2688.35, close 2694.22) closed at its high but the next four bars (113-116: closes 2691.88, 2691.48, 2690.11, 2685.72) failed to exceed 2694.43 and gave the move back, and bar 119 is a 0.73-range doji-inside bar offering neither a stop entry above nor a reversal below.

Location is crowded in both directions, so neither Trader's Equation test clears: overhead sits the H1 bear reversal bar 94 (1790301600000, high 2699.53, close 2674.11), and support sits at the H1 bar 107 low 2669.67 (1790348400000) and M15 bar 106 low 2680 (1790382600000), only a fraction of a percent from the close.
evidence_against: D1 is Always-In Long in breakout mode with rising swing lows, and H4 bars 110-119 compress in breakout mode between 2633.31 and 2740.42, so a continuation long above the M15 band top 2694.43 (M15 bar 110, 1790386200000) with invalidation below 2678.85 (M15 bar 96, 1790373600000) is a coherent pending stop; it is not triggered at decision_time_ms 1790395199999.
M15 has printed mildly higher lows since bar 106 (2680) and H1 held above 2669.67 (bar 107), so the tight range can still resolve upward into the D1 bull.

A short is also arguable from the H4 lower-high sequence (2850, 2804.59, 2786.81, 2740.42) plus the H1 bear reversal at 2699.53 (bar 94), but no M15 close below 2678.85 with follow-through has occurred, so it is equally untriggered.
uncertainty: Both directions have an untriggered, plausible stop; without a break of 2694.43 or 2678.85 the entry side is genuinely undetermined at the frozen decision time.
The supplied H4 context is stale (decision_time_ms 1790380799999) and describes the same pause as a range with a candidate mtr-like top, so the trend-versus-range read above M15 is unsettled.
D1 and H4 label the same consolidation differently (channel/two-sided pause versus 27-bar range), so continuation risk and reversal risk cannot be ranked from supplied closed bars alone.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 close above 2694.43 (bar 110 high, 1790386200000) with the following bar closing higher would exit the 2678.85-2694.43 band and re-open a D1-aligned long breakout-pullback read.
An M15 close below 2678.85 (bar 96 low, 1790373600000) with follow-through toward 2669.67 (H1 bar 107 low) would shift the read toward a lower-high short against the H4 2804.59-2633.31 range.
An H1 close above 2738.74 (bar 103 high, 1790334000000) would confirm D1 breakout-mode continuation; an H1 close below 2633.31 would break the H4 higher-low sequence and enlarge the trading range.
Five or more further M15 bars overlapping inside 2678.85-2694.43 without a break would keep the tight-range, no-trade read in force.

market_context.d1_current: Bull trend in a channel, always_in long, with a four-bar pause between 2633.31 and 2786.81 under the 2850 high and no reversal bar.

setup.type: tight trading range; no directional setup at the decision time

evidence_for: H1 bar 119 (open_time 1790427600000, close_time 1790431199999) prints open 2688.15, high 2688.23, low 2680.87, close 2684.43: a 7.36-point bar closing in its lower half, inside the prior bars' range, so there is no breakout bar and no follow-through to trade.

H1 bars 103-119 (1790370000000-1790431199999) overlap inside 2676.22 (bar 103 low) and 2695.17 (bar 114 high, open_time 1790409600000): a tight trading range whose middle offers no Brooks entry edge in either direction.

Location is neutral-to-poor for both sides: the final M15 close 2684.43 (1790430300000) is near the middle of the H4 range 2633.31-2804.59, so a long is not bought at the range low and a short is not sold at the range high, and a short would also oppose the D1 always_in long and the H4 higher-low sequence (2358.62, 2568.16, 2633.31).

No signal bar qualifies for reversal: recent bear bodies are tiny (H1 bar 119 body 3.72 points, H1 bar 118 body 0.97 points), and there is no bar closing below the 2676.22 H1 range low to confirm a downside break of the consolidation.
evidence_against: Strongest counterargument (long): D1 and H4 both read always_in long with a bull-trend primary regime, H4 swing lows rise (2358.62, 2568.16, 2633.31) and price sits above the 2643.52 breakout-point test, so a pending stop above the H1 high 2695.17 (bar 114, open_time 1790409600000) could be graded as a breakout-pullback continuation with invalidation at the H1 low 2676.22 (bar 103, open_time 1790370000000).

Strongest counterargument (short): H1 highs stepped down from 2740.42 (bar 93, open_time 1790334000000) to 2721.75 (bar 94) to 2696.07 (bar 96) and have since flattened under 2696, so a pending stop below 2676.22 (bar 103 low) would target the 2633.31 H4 range low, and H4 evidence_against itself flags a possible final flag under 2804.59 with a 45% retracement.

Micro-signal counterargument: the final M15 bar 1790430300000 (open 2682.52, low 2682.42, close 2684.43) is a bull bar closing at its high while holding above the prior bar low 2680.87, a small bull setup for a scalp toward 2691-2695 if a stop above 2684.43 triggers; it is not yet a breakout and no bar after it is available to confirm or fail.
uncertainty: Whether the low-volume compression is a breakout precursor or a quiet drift cannot be resolved from closed bars: H1 bar 119 volume is 499,924 versus 2,852,582 on the 1790172000000 break bar and 2,180,231 on the 1790240400000 break bar.

H4 lists always_in long but phase 'range' with always_in_relevance 'low' and lower highs (2804.59, 2786.81, 2740.42), so the H4 label and the raw H4 structure pull in different directions for a directional entry.

Both directional stops remain untriggered and un-failed at the frozen time, so neither the long-above-2695.17 nor the short-below-2676.22 case can be graded as triggered, present, or failed from supplied bars.
conditions_that_change_market_read: Bull resolution: an M15/H1 close above 2695.17 (H1 bar 114 high, open_time 1790409600000) and then above 2721.75 (H1 bar 94 high, open_time 1790337600000) with widening ranges and a following higher close would turn the tight range into a breakout-pullback long setup.

Bear resolution: a close below 2676.22 (H1 bar 103 low, open_time 1790370000000) followed by a close below 2633.31 (H1 bar 68 low, open_time 1790244000000) would break the H4 higher low and shift the read toward a bear leg rather than a bull-range pause.

Range expansion: a wide-range M15 bar closing at its extreme and clearing 2691.38 (M15 1790424900000 high) or 2680.87 (M15 1790429400000 low) with follow-through would end the tight trading range and supply the missing actionable trigger.

setup.type: no actionable signal: mid-range tight trading range

evidence_for: M15 pressure is a 16-point band: bars 1790413200000 through 1790438399999 hold inside low 2679.27 and high 2695.17; the final bar (close_time 1790438399999) is O 2692.14 H 2692.24 L 2689.12 C 2691.88, a 3.12-point range, and M15 bar open_time 1790433900000 is O 2688.07 H 2688.34 L 2688.07 C 2688.07, a one-price doji. No wide-range breakout bar and no follow-through bar exist to trigger either direction.

H1 agrees: the recent H1 bars close between 2680.27 (open_time 1790370000000) and 2691.88 (open_time 1790434800000) with highs capped at 2695.17 (open_time 1790409600000) and lows at 2679.27 (open_time 1790413200000) - a two-sided overlap rather than trend, with several 1-2 point bars.

Volume supports indifference, not conviction: M15 volumes fall to 25,190.447 (open_time 1790372700000), 1,118.097 (open_time 1790433900000) and 37,606.329 (open_time 1790434800000), i.e. thin two-sided trade, not an impulse.

Location is the middle of both larger structures: 2691 is roughly mid of the H4 post-spike range 2633.31-2804.59 and mid of the D1 four-bar pause 2633.31-2786.81, so any stop entry here must travel a long way to an edge while sitting next to the opposite edge.

Raw H4 read (last 12 closed bars) shows step-down highs 2740.42 (open_time 1790323200000), 2721.75 (1790337600000), 2696.09 (1790352000000), 2694.43 (1790380800000), 2695.17 (1790409600000), 2694.73 (1790424000000) with heavy overlap and shrinking ranges - a trading range, not an accepted bull breakout.
evidence_against: Bull case: D1 context is Always-In Long in breakout mode with rising swing lows and highs, and H4 keeps the higher low 2568.16 intact while price sits only about 65 points above the 2643.52 breakout high; the last H4 bar (open_time 1790424000000) closed 2691.88 above its 2689.14 open and the last H1 bar closed 2691.88 within 2.85 of its 2694.73 high.

Bull continuation could resolve from this compression: a stop above the M15 high 2695.17 (M15 open_time 1790409600000) would target the H4 lower highs 2721.75 and 2740.42, so the tight range can also be read as a bull flag under 2740.42.

Rebuttal: that requires a wide-range close above 2695.17 with a following bar closing higher, which the supplied bars do not show, and the nearest invalidation would sit at the compression low 2679.27 while the opposing range edge 2633.31 is far below - hostile trader's-equation location for a mid-range long.
uncertainty: H4 context is stale; my raw H4 read covered only the last 12 closed bars, so the full 120-bar H4 picture was not re-verified (acceptability: no entry is returned).
Whether the 16-point H1/M15 compression is a bull flag under 2740.42 or simply the middle of the H4/D1 range is unresolved without a breakout bar and follow-through.
Volume is exceptionally thin and falling, so the follow-through quality of any eventual breakout is unknown from the supplied bars.
conditions_that_change_market_read: A wide-range M15 close above 2695.17 (M15 open_time 1790409600000 high) followed by a close above 2721.75 (H4 open_time 1790337600000 high) would shift the read to a breakout-spike long rather than a range middle.
A close below 2679.27 (M15 open_time 1790413200000 low) and then below 2669.67 (H4 open_time 1790337600000 low) would open the path toward 2633.31 and argue for the bear resolution.
A close below 2633.31 with follow-through would break the higher-low sequence and the approximate double bottom with 2357.18, weakening the Always-In Long read.
Continued closes inside 2679.27-2695.17 on shrinking bars would keep the no-trade tight trading range read.

evidence_against: Strongest opposing case (bull continuation): D1 is Always-In long with high relevance and the H4 pullback low 2633.31 held above the 50% level (2604.31) of the 2358.62-2850.00 leg, while M15 lows after bar 102 rise (2680.87, 2682.42, 2683.35, 2684.40, 2687.00, 2687.88, 2688.36, 2689.76), so a bull flag could be resolved by a stop above M15 bar 110 high 2694.73; but that stop sits only ~1.36 points under the 2696.09 range top (bar 25 high) while invalidation under bar 117 low 2685.82 risks ~8.91 points, so the nearby opposing structure crowds the setup.

A short case exists at the range top (repeated failures at 2696.09/2695.35/2695.17/2694.73), but the 14-bar 8.91-point M15 band makes any stop wider than the range, and H4 lows since 1790236800000 are rising (2633.31, 2640.00, 2667.22, 2669.67) - a squeeze rather than a confirmed breakdown, so the short is equally unsupported.
uncertainty: The M15 2685.82-2694.73 cluster is breakout mode; direction is unresolved at the decision time and range breakouts are two-sided.
D1 bull-trend continuation above 2696.09 and then 2740.42 remains possible but no bar in the supplied data has closed above 2696.09 after bar 25.

market_context.d1_context: current, bull-trend/always-in long with high relevance but a four-bar pause 2633.31-2786.81 under the 2850 high and no close above 2786.81
market_context.read: H1/M15 raw bars are authoritative and show a range middle; neither edge trade is available at 2684.86, so the correct action is to wait for a breakout of 2665.14 or 2699.53/2721.75.

setup.type: range-middle / tight-range breakout-mode, no edge entry

evidence_for: H1 bars 90-119 (1790352000000-1790459999999) hold inside roughly 2665.14-2699.53 with overlapping ranges; the highest H1 close in that stretch is 2692.59 (bar 93) and the last H1 close 2684.86 (bar 119) is mid-range, about 10 points below the 2693-2696 high cluster (H1 bar 113 high 2694.73, bar 93 high 2695.35, bar 74 high 2695.62) and about 20 points above M15 bar 115 low 2665.14, a poor long location and a short straight into a just-closed bull bar.

M15 bars 118-119 (O 2685.99 H 2690.11 L 2685.11 C 2685.43; O 2685.43 H 2685.67 L 2682.67 C 2684.86) are small overlapping bars with no follow-through above 2690.11; bar 118 leaves a 4.68-point upper tail and bar 119 closes below its open, so the 115-117 leg has stalled rather than broken out.

H4 context is current and two-sided: post-climax range 2633.31-2804.59 with lower highs 2804.59, 2778.33, 2740.42 and last close 2683.22 below the 2718.95 midpoint; the last eight H4 bars coil 2669.67-2721.75 with 7.68-18.16-point ranges, a Brooks breakout-mode condition in which direction is unresolved.
D1 context is current but shows a four-bar pause 2633.31-2786.81 under the 2850 high with no close above 2786.81, so the larger bull trend supplies no M15 trigger at this price.
evidence_against: Bull case against abstaining: M15 bar 115 (O 2670.85 H 2676.05 L 2665.14 C 2675.70) is a failed bear breakout under the H4 coil low 2669.67 that closes near its high, and bars 116 (C 2679.69 = H) and 117 (C 2686.37 = H) follow through, so a stop above bar 118 high 2690.11 with structural risk under 2665.14 is a defensible bull-flag-within-range long, supported by D1 always-in long (high relevance).

Bear case against abstaining: H4 highs step down after the 2850.00 spike and price closed under the 2718.95 midpoint, so a short near the 2693-2696 H1 high cluster (H1 bar 113 high 2694.73) with risk above 2699.53 (H1 bar 76 high) targets 2665.14 and 2633.31.

Both cases are edge trades that need a better price than the 2684.86 close; at the current print the long risks about 20 points for about 10 to first resistance and the short fights the still-rising 115-117 leg.
uncertainty: M15 bar 119 closes at exactly the decision time (open 1790459100000, close 1790459999999) and is treated as closed here; if the host treats it as forming, the two-bar stall is one bar weaker.
The H4 tight coil 2669.67-2721.75 direction is unresolved and H4 is tagged always_in unclear/low, so H4 describes rather than votes.
No raw H4 or D1 read was required because both contexts are tagged current; a disputed freshness tag would add the H4 read to the entry check.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 close above 2699.53 (H1 bar 76 high) on a wide-range bull bar with a higher following close would turn the read into a range breakout and make a breakout-pullback long actionable.
An M15 close below 2665.14 with follow-through would confirm a bear breakout of the coil and shift the read toward a short setup.
Continued closes between about 2665 and 2696 with heavy overlap keep this a range and keep mid-range entries on the no-trade list.

market_context.M15: Tight trading range / breakout-mode coil: bars 108-119 hold inside 2665.14-2691.43 (26.29 points) and bars 116-119 share a common overlap of only 2687.27-2688.92; high 2691.43 is duplicated on bars 116 and 117 with no breakout either way.
market_context.H4: Current context: 32-bar trading range 2633.31-2804.59 after the bar-88 climax spike (191.94-point range, 126.85-point upper tail); always_in unclear, low relevance; 8-bar tight coil 2669.67-2721.75; close 2683.22 below the 2718.95 midpoint.
market_context.D1: Current context: bull-trend with always_in long at high relevance, but a four-bar pause (1790035200000-1790294400000) inside 2633.31-2786.81, closes 2752.43/2684.16/2686.59/2690.56, no new high above 2850 and no follow-through bar.

evidence_for: M15 tight range, no trigger: bars 116-119 (1790460000000, 1790460900000, 1790461800000, 1790462700000) share a common overlap of only 2687.27-2688.92, highs 2691.43/2691.43/2688.92/2689.09 and lows 2682.67/2687.27/2686/2686; final bar 119 spans just 3.09 points (open 2686.07, high 2689.09, low 2686, close 2687.72), so neither side has produced a breakout bar.

M15 coil is two-sided, not trending: bars 108-119 (1790452800000-1790463599999) stay inside 2665.14 (bar 111 low, 1790455500000) to 2691.43; bar 110 (1790454600000) is a 12.28-point bear bar (open 2683.1, high 2683.12, close 2670.85) and is immediately reversed by bar 112 (1790456400000) closing 2679.69, so any breakout attempt so far has been absorbed.

H1 shows no net progress: bar 105 (1790409600000) close 2689.77 versus bar 119 (1790460000000) close 2687.72, with all closes between 2675.7 and 2691.88 in between; H1 bar 117 (1790452800000) low 2665.14 closed 2675.7, a recovery inside the same bar rather than a bear breakout.

Location is mid-range: M15 close 2687.72 sits below the H4 range midpoint 2718.95 and far above the H4 range floor 2633.31, i.e. the middle of the 32-bar H4 range 2633.31-2804.59, not an edge. Overhead H1 supply is crowded just above the coil: bar 75 (1790301600000) high 2699.53, bar 82 (1790326800000) high 2712.49, bar 84 (1790334000000) high 2740.42, roughly 8 points above the 2691.43 coil high versus about 17 points down to the M15 bar 112 low 2674.73.

D1 context: the last four D1 bars (1790035200000-1790294400000) overlap inside 2633.31-2786.81 (closes 2752.43, 2684.16, 2686.59, 2690.56) with no new high over 2850 and no follow-through bar, so the pattern is a pause at the highs, not an active breakout leg.
Secondary: M15 volume contracts into the coil (bar 119 volume 194028.281 versus bar 116 volume 569805.913), showing no expansion behind either direction.
evidence_against: Strongest bull case for entering: D1 is bull-trend with always_in long at high relevance and the H4 context keeps rising swing lows 2358.62 to 2569.80 to 2641.70 with the 2633.31 pullback low reversed within one bar, so the H4 range can be read as a bull flag; on M15 the lows rise 2665.14 (bar 111) to 2674.73 (bar 112) to 2679.65 (bar 113) to 2682.67 (bar 116) while highs are pinned near 2691.43, an ascending-triangle / breakout-mode shape. A buy stop above 2691.43 with invalidation at 2674.73 would be a defined-risk long inside an intact bull trend.

No bear resolution exists: bars 108-119 have not closed below 2665.14 and the H4 range floor 2633.31 has held for 60 H1 bars, so a bull continuation out of the coil cannot be called failed from the supplied closed bars.
uncertainty: Direction of the tight-range / breakout-mode resolution is unresolved: H4 always_in is unclear with low relevance, and the M15 coil highs (2691.43) and lows (2665.14) are both untouched at the decision time.
It cannot be determined from closed bars whether the M15 rising lows are bull-flag accumulation or ordinary range rotation, because no breakout bar with follow-through exists to grade.

The H4 context decision_time_ms 1790452799999 and the D1 context decision_time_ms 1790380799999 precede the frozen decision time; the newer H1 bars 118-119 still sit inside the same coil, so the context read appears current but is not bar-for-bar synchronized.
conditions_that_change_market_read: A close above 2691.43 followed by a close above the H1 highs 2699.53 (bar 75) / 2712.49 (bar 82) would mark a bull breakout of the coil and shift the read toward a breakout-pullback long.

A close below 2665.14 (M15 bar 111 low) with follow-through under 2648.49 (H1 bar 80 low 2648.49) and 2633.31 (H1 bar 59 low) would mark a bear breakout of the H4 range and shift the read toward a short.

A move to an H4 range edge (2804.59 top or 2633.31 floor) with a decisive signal bar would create the edge location the current mid-range price does not offer; continued closes between 2686 and 2691.43 keep the coil and the NO_TRADE read unchanged.

setup.type: marginal M15 breakout of the H4 8-bar tight range (2696.09) with a two-bar bear pullback; neither a clean long continuation nor a confirmed short reversal

evidence_for: M15 idx 117 (open_time 1790475300000) prints high 2703.66, the session high, but the next two bars are bear bars: idx 118 (1790476200000) O 2702.75 H 2702.86 L 2699.59 C 2699.61, and idx 119 (1790477100000) O 2699.61 H 2699.61 L 2696.59 C 2696.78, closing 0.19 above its low. The breakout bar idx 115 (1790473500000, O 2694.18 H 2703.08 C 2700.45) cleared the H4 8-bar tight-range top 2696.09 by only ~7 points and gained no same-direction follow-through before the freeze.

Location: at 2696.78 the decision price is in the upper-middle of the H4 20-bar range 2633.31-2740.42 (context, current) and in the middle of the D1 five-bar overlap 2633.31-2786.81. A long here is mid-range, not at a range edge, and the presumed stop entry above 2699.61/2703.66 would be buying directly into the lower-high supply sequence 2721.75 / 2740.42 / 2786.81 / 2804.59 cited in the current H4 context.

H4 context (current, decision_time 1790467199999): last 20 bars hold closes in 2647.90-2715.90 with heavy adjacent overlap and no two consecutive same-direction trend bars; bars 113-120 compress to a 30.95-point band with ranges 7.68-29.82 and volume ~1.91M-3.47M versus ~7.0M-9.0M around the 2850 high. Contraction with no directional resolution is range behaviour, not a trend continuation signal.

H1 agrees on the immediate turn: H1 idx 119 (open_time 1790474400000, O 2700.46 H 2703.66 L 2696.59 C 2696.78) closes at its low, and late-window H1 volume (~0.34M-1.0M) is roughly half the ~1.5M-2.2M seen earlier in the same window, so the push off 2665.14 (M15 idx 95 low, matched by the H4 8-bar range low) lacks participation.
evidence_against: Strongest bull case (not chosen): D1 is bull-trend/channel with always-in long and higher swing lows, the H4 tight-range top 2696.09 was exceeded on M15 idx 115, and the pullback held above it (idx 119 low 2696.59 > 2696.09). That defines a breakout-pullback long stop above idx 119 high 2699.61 with structural invalidation at idx 115 low 2693.97, i.e. a defensible entry with a tight structural stop had the location been better.

Strongest bear case (not chosen): the last two M15 bars are bear bars with the final bar closing 0.19 above its low at a lower high (2703.66 vs 2721.75), so a short stop below idx 119 low 2696.59 back into the tight range is also definable. But the breakout is only two bars old, so it is a forming attempt, not a shown failure, and the D1 bull trend plus higher H1 lows opposes it.
uncertainty: H4 current context calls the regime a trading range (lower highs, breakout-mode tight range) while D1 current context calls it a bull-trend channel with always-in long; the packet does not resolve that regime disagreement, and either context alone is a fallible description.

Around the decision the M15 bars are 1-3 points wide (idx 118 range 3.27; idx 119 range 3.02), so close location, tails and sequence are noise-prone and a 'breakout held' versus 'breakout stalling' distinction rests on a 0.69-point gap between idx 119 low 2696.59 and the 2696.09 H4 tight-range top.
The freeze falls two M15 bars after the breakout bar idx 115, so whether the breakout resolves upward or fails back into the range is genuinely unshown by closed bars.

setup.type: marginal M15 breakout of the H4 8-bar tight range (2696.09) with a two-bar bear pullback; neither a clean long continuation nor a confirmed short reversal

evidence_for: M15 idx 117 (open_time 1790475300000) prints high 2703.66, the session high, but the next two bars are bear bars: idx 118 (1790476200000) O 2702.75 H 2702.86 L 2699.59 C 2699.61, and idx 119 (1790477100000) O 2699.61 H 2699.61 L 2696.59 C 2696.78, closing 0.19 above its low. The breakout bar idx 115 (1790473500000, O 2694.18 H 2703.08 C 2700.45) cleared the H4 8-bar tight-range top 2696.09 by only ~7 points and gained no same-direction follow-through before the freeze.

Location: at 2696.78 the decision price is in the upper-middle of the H4 20-bar range 2633.31-2740.42 (context, current) and in the middle of the D1 five-bar overlap 2633.31-2786.81. A long here is mid-range, not at a range edge, and the presumed stop entry above 2699.61/2703.66 would be buying directly into the lower-high supply sequence 2721.75 / 2740.42 / 2786.81 / 2804.59 cited in the current H4 context.

H4 context (current, decision_time 1790467199999): last 20 bars hold closes in 2647.90-2715.90 with heavy adjacent overlap and no two consecutive same-direction trend bars; bars 113-120 compress to a 30.95-point band with ranges 7.68-29.82 and volume ~1.91M-3.47M versus ~7.0M-9.0M around the 2850 high. Contraction with no directional resolution is range behaviour, not a trend continuation signal.

H1 agrees on the immediate turn: H1 idx 119 (open_time 1790474400000, O 2700.46 H 2703.66 L 2696.59 C 2696.78) closes at its low, and late-window H1 volume (~0.34M-1.0M) is roughly half the ~1.5M-2.2M seen earlier in the same window, so the push off 2665.14 (M15 idx 95 low, matched by the H4 8-bar range low) lacks participation.
evidence_against: Strongest bull case (not chosen): D1 is bull-trend/channel with always-in long and higher swing lows, the H4 tight-range top 2696.09 was exceeded on M15 idx 115, and the pullback held above it (idx 119 low 2696.59 > 2696.09). That defines a breakout-pullback long stop above idx 119 high 2699.61 with structural invalidation at idx 115 low 2693.97, i.e. a defensible entry with a tight structural stop had the location been better.

Strongest bear case (not chosen): the last two M15 bars are bear bars with the final bar closing 0.19 above its low at a lower high (2703.66 vs 2721.75), so a short stop below idx 119 low 2696.59 back into the tight range is also definable. But the breakout is only two bars old, so it is a forming attempt, not a shown failure, and the D1 bull trend plus higher H1 lows opposes it.
uncertainty: H4 current context calls the regime a trading range (lower highs, breakout-mode tight range) while D1 current context calls it a bull-trend channel with always-in long; the packet does not resolve that regime disagreement, and either context alone is a fallible description.

Around the decision the M15 bars are 1-3 points wide (idx 118 range 3.27; idx 119 range 3.02), so close location, tails and sequence are noise-prone and a 'breakout held' versus 'breakout stalling' distinction rests on a 0.69-point gap between idx 119 low 2696.59 and the 2696.09 H4 tight-range top.
The freeze falls two M15 bars after the breakout bar idx 115, so whether the breakout resolves upward or fails back into the range is genuinely unshown by closed bars.
Volume is treated only as secondary context; it is not part of the entry case.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 close above 2703.66 (idx 117 high) followed by another same-direction close would confirm the tight-range breakout and upgrade a breakout-pullback long above 2699.61 to an actionable set-up.
An M15 close below 2693.97 (idx 115 low) would put price back inside the H4 8-bar tight range 2665.14-2696.09 and shift the read to a failed breakout / rotation toward 2682.67 then 2665.14.

An H4 close above 2740.42 would end the lower-high sequence and restore the bull continuation read; an H4 close below 2665.14 and then 2633.31 would confirm a bear breakout of the 20-bar range 2633.31-2740.42.

market_context.phase: breakout_mode_contraction
market_context.higher_timeframe_bias: D1 bull-trend (always_in long, current, medium relevance) but no follow-through above the 2850 high; H4 trading-range with a lower-high sequence after 2850.
market_context.location: Price 2695.79 sits inside the H4 eight-bar tight band 2665.14-2696.09 and near the middle of the 20-bar H4 range 2633.31-2740.42 (midpoint 2686.87), i.e. mid-range, not an edge.
market_context.h4_data_note: Supplied H4 context was stale; 120 closed raw H4 bars were read successfully and are the basis for H4 statements.

evidence_for: Location is mid-range: the 20-bar H4 range is 2633.31 (H4 bar open 1790236800000 low) to 2740.42 (H4 bar open 1790323200000 high), midpoint 2686.87, and the last closed price is 2695.79 (M15 index 119 close) - about 9 points above the midpoint and about 45 below the range top, i.e. the middle of a two-sided range rather than an edge.

The eight-bar H4 contraction 2665.14-2696.09 (H4 bars open 1790352000000 high 2696.09 through open 1790452800000 low 2665.14) has not been resolved on a close: the last-hour push reached 2703.66 (H1 index 118 open 1790474400000 high 2703.66; M15 index 113 open 1790475300000 high 2703.66) and price closed back inside at 2695.79 (M15 index 119 close, below the 2696.09 band top) - an unresolved breakout-mode attempt, not a confirmed breakout.

Overhead structure is a lower-high sequence: 2740.42 (H1 index 79 open 1790334000000 high), 2721.75 (H1 index 80 open 1790337600000 high), then 2703.66 (H1 index 118) - buying a stop above 2703.66 faces resistance within roughly 37 points while a 2665.14 invalidation is roughly 38.5 points away, a sub-1 qualitative Trader's Equation.

No bull follow-through after the push: H1 index 116 (open 1790467200000) closes 2692.33 below its 2694.96 open, H1 index 118 closes 2696.78 below its 2700.46 open, and the last M15 bar (index 119, open 1790480700000) opens 2696.6 and closes 2695.79 in the lower half of its 2695.29-2696.6 range.

The short side offers no trigger either: 2665.14 held (M15 index 91 open 1790455500000 low 2665.14) and the last completed full H4 bar (open 1790452800000) probed 2665.14 and closed at its 2694.96 high, so a sell stop below the band would be selling into support with the D1 bull bias still intact.
evidence_against: The strongest entry case is a bull breakout stop above 2703.66: D1 context is bull-trend with always_in long, and the H4 sequence still holds the higher lows 2358.62 -> 2436.87 (H4 bar open 1789689600000 low) after the 2648.49/2633.31 dip, so a tight-range breakout in the trend direction is a legitimate Brooks tight-range trade.

The last completed full H4 bar (open 1790452800000: open 2683.22, low 2665.14, close 2694.96) is a bull reversal bar closing at the top of the eight-bar band, and the next hour again reversed up from 2690.83 to 2703.66 - buyers defended 2665.14 twice, which weakens the case that the band resolves down.

Contraction with falling H4 volume around 1.9M-3.9M versus about 7.0M-9.0M near the 2850 high is classic breakout mode, and with the higher-timeframe bias up the first expansion is arguably more likely upward than downward.
D1 acceptance above the prior range top is intact (D1 closes 2612.02, 2632.98, 2642.9, 2775.61 above 2557.46), so a breakout long is aligned with the larger trend rather than countertrend.
uncertainty: The eight-bar band 2665.14-2696.09 is unresolved breakout mode; both edge stops are live and the direction is genuinely two-sided, so this is a location/no-edge abstention rather than a failed pattern.

D1 context is current but medium-confidence and shows no follow-through above the 2850 high; the last five D1 bars overlap 2633.31-2786.81, so the higher-timeframe up-bias is unconfirmed at the decision point.

The final entry in the supplied 120-bar H4 read (open 1790467200000) aggregates only one hour (volume 2,885,569.975 equals the last four H1 bars), so the very latest H4 reading is a partial-window bar rather than a complete four-hour bar.
Volume is used only as contraction context; its absence or decline is not treated as a veto.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An H1/H4 close above 2703.66 followed by a second bar holding above it would resolve the eight-bar band upward and create a bull breakout entry.
A close below 2665.14 (M15 index 91 low) and then below 2633.31 on wide range bars would confirm a bear breakout of the contraction and the 20-bar range.
Two consecutive H4 closes above 2740.42 would break the lower-high sequence 2740.42 -> 2721.75 -> 2703.66 and argue the H4 pullback resolved up.
Continued bar-by-bar overlap inside 2665.14-2696.09 keeps the breakout mode unresolved and sustains the no-trade read.

market_context.M15: bull leg from the 2665.14 low into the top of the H4 coil; last two bars stall just under 2709.84

setup.type: breakout attempt at the top of a higher-timeframe range

evidence_for: M15 bar 114 (open_time 1790487000000, open 2695.39, high 2707.70, close 2703.22) is a wide bull bar closing 3.48 below its high, and bar 116 (1790488800000, open 2703.99, high 2709.00, close 2708.70) followed through, so the last ~40 M15 bars have a bull tilt off the 2665.14 low (M15 bar 79, low 2665.14, close 2675.70).

H1 last closed bar (open_time 1790488800000, open 2703.99, high 2709.84, low 2703.98, close 2706.03) closed in the top quarter of its range after two higher H1 closes (2700.45 at 1790470800000, 2704.00 at 1790485200000), so the hourly sequence since the 2665.14 low is a series of higher lows and higher highs.

H4 context reports unbroken higher swing lows 2358.62 -> 2568.16 -> 2633.31 -> 2665.14 and bars 119-120 closing at the coil high (2694.96, 2695.79), so no higher-timeframe support has broken and the Always-In question on H4 is genuinely unresolved rather than bearish.
evidence_against: Location: the last M15 close 2706.03 (bar 119) sits 3.81 below the 20-bar M15 high 2709.84 and 15.72 below the H4 coil top 2721.75, so a long here buys the top of a 34-bar, 2665.14-2721.75 H4 range - neither at the range low nor after a confirmed break above the range high.

The push has stalled: M15 bars 118 (open 2708.63, close 2706.30) and 119 (open 2706.30, high 2708.08, close 2706.03) close below the prior closes 2708.70/2708.63 with shrinking bodies, and no M15 bar has traded above 2709.84, so there is no breakout trigger and no follow-through above resistance.

Overhead opposing structure is crowded versus invalidation: the H4 coil top 2721.75 and the 2740.42 H4 lower high (bar 110) are only ~16-34 points above, while the nearest M15 structural low is 2690.36 (20-bar range low) ~15.7 points below and the real invalidation 2665.14 (M15 bar 79 low) ~41 points below.

D1 context: the last five daily bars overlap inside 2633.31-2786.81, the final D1 close 2694.96 is 155.04 below the 2850 high, so the daily is two-sided at the highs rather than trending; a fresh long at 2706-2709 has little measured room before that overlap.
uncertainty: H4 breakout mode is unresolved: the 2665.14-2721.75 coil could resolve up into D1 bull-trend continuation or down through 2633.31 into the mtr-like lower high.
The last two M15 doji-like bars (118-119) may be a pause before continuation rather than the start of a pullback; either way no trigger exists at the frozen time.
Whether the M15 push above the 2699.82 shelf (bars 104-107) is a genuine breakout or just the upper half of the H4 coil is not resolved by the closed bars.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 close above 2721.75 (H4 coil top) with the next bar holding above it would convert this from a range-top entry into a confirmed breakout continuation, making a long trigger above that close actionable.
A pullback that holds above 2690.36 and prints a bull reversal bar near 2690-2694 would offer a breakout-pullback long with a tight invalidation instead of buying the range top.
An M15 close below 2665.14 and then below 2633.31 would establish the H4 mtr-like lower high and shift the read toward a bear leg or range breakdown.

market_context.D1_regime: bull-trend/channel but last five bars overlap 2633.31-2786.81, 2850 high untested
market_context.H1_read: bull micro channel to 2718.83; last H1 bar (index 119) closed at its low 2713.46
market_context.location: upper third of the H4 tight range, immediately under 2721.75

evidence_for: M15 index 116 (open_time 1790496000000, close_time 1790496899999; open 2717.24, high 2718.83, low 2713.77, close 2715.86) prints the highest M15 price, only 2.92 under the H1 swing high 2721.75 (H1 index 75, open_time 1790337600000, high 2721.75), so a stop entry above 2718.83 is a buy INTO overhead resistance rather than through it.

M15 indices 117-119 (1790496900000, 1790497800000, 1790498700000) close 2715.86, 2714.32, 2713.46 with declining closes, and index 119 closes at its low (open 2714.32, high 2714.87, low 2713.46, close 2713.46); the H1 bar ending 1790499599999 (index 119: open 2717.24, high 2718.83, low 2713.46, close 2713.46) also closed at its low, so the 2718.83 probe has no closed-bar follow-through.

Location is the top of a range: at 2713.46 price sits at 64% of the H4 tight range 2665.14 (H4 bar 118 low) to 2740.42 (H4 bar 109 high) and inside the wider H4 post-spike range 2633.31-2804.59; the candidate long invalidation 2713.46 is only 5.37 below the 2718.83 trigger while the first opposing level 2721.75 is 2.92 above it, so nearby structure crowds the setup relative to its invalidation.

H4 highs step down 2804.59 (bar 88) to 2786.81 (bar 96) to 2740.42 (bar 109) with no close above 2740.42, and the D1 window's last five bars overlap inside 2633.31-2786.81 with the 2850 high (1789948800000) still untested, so a long here is a fresh attempt into a proven range top rather than an accepted breakout.
evidence_against: Last closed H4 bar (open_time 1790481600000, close_time 1790495999999; open 2695.79, high 2717.27, low 2690.36, close 2717.24) is a bull bar closing on its high after the higher low 2665.14 (H4 bar open_time 1790452800000) and is the highest H4 close in 24 bars - a valid bull signal in breakout mode if 2718.83/2721.75 are cleared.

M15 shows a connected bull micro channel: higher lows 2665.14 (index 71), 2704.44 (index 112), 2710.66 (index 115) with bull bars closing on highs at 2703.22 (index 106, high 2707.7) and 2717.24 (index 115, high 2717.27), so a continuation buy above 2718.83 fits the prevailing leg rather than a counter-trend probe.

Both supplied contexts are always-in long with D1 bull-trend and higher lows holding 2357.18/2358.62, so the trend tiebreaker in a tight breakout-mode range favours the upside, and a wider invalidation under 2704.44 would change the crowding arithmetic while keeping the same location.
H4 bars 109-119 contracted to roughly 9-27 point ranges with the 2665.14 higher low intact; in Brooks terms that is an unresolved pause that can resolve upward, not a confirmed failure.
uncertainty: The 2713.46-2718.83 pause is unresolved at the frozen time; the closed bars do not yet show whether it is a bull flag or a rolled-over probe at the range top.
Choice of the operative H4 boundary (2740.42 tight-range top versus 2804.59 post-spike top) moves the location read between 'range top' and 'mid-range'.
The nearest resistance 2721.75 is an H1/H4 derived level, not an M15 OHLC field, so the trigger that this read rejects cannot be expressed with an exact M15 price above it.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 close above 2721.75 followed by a second close above 2740.42 would move the H4 read from range to bull breakout and make a long at this location acceptable.
A break below 2704.44 (M15 index 112 low) and then 2665.14 (M15 index 71 low, H4 bar 118 low) would confirm failure at the highs and shift the read to a bear leg inside the H4 range.
Continued closes inside 2713.46-2718.83 on small overlapping M15 ranges keeps the breakout-mode pause unresolved and this a no-trade location.

setup.type: no_actionable_setup: failed coil-top poke followed by a 4-bar M15 bear micro-channel into the middle of the range

evidence_for: M15 bars 116-119 (open_times 1790517600000, 1790518500000, 1790519400000, 1790520300000) close 2705.82, 2694.31, 2689.23, 2686.71 - four consecutive bear bars from the 2708.79 high of bar 116 to the 2682.40 low of bar 119 with no bull reversal bar, so no long signal exists at the frozen close.

M15 bar 119 (open 2689.23, high 2689.56, low 2682.40, close 2686.71) closes only 4.31 above its low and the H1 bar closing 1790521199999 (open 2708.45, high 2708.79, low 2682.40, close 2686.71) closes in the lower quartile of a 26.39 range, so the immediate bar-by-bar pressure is down, not a completed bull pullback entry.

Location is mid-range, where neither side has an edge: 2686.71 is ~5.3 below the midpoint (~2692.0) of the H4 coil 2665.14-2718.83 that the H4 context reports as an 11-bar two-sided hold (1790352000000-1790510399999), and inside the D1 two-sided band 2633.31-2786.81.

Short-side geometry is crowded: invalidation would have to sit above the 2708.79 high of M15 bar 116 / H1 bar 1790517600000 (~22 points) while the nearest support is the coil low 2665.14 (~21 points), roughly 1:1 against nearby support inside a bull-trend context.

The coil top was a failed poke with no follow-through: M15 bars 91-94 (1790495100000-1790497800000) print highs 2717.27, 2718.83, 2718.28, 2718.83 yet close only 2717.24, 2715.86, 2715.06, 2714.32, and the H4 bar 1790496000000 pokes 2718.83 and closes 2709.21 in its lower half - a two-sided, unresolved breakout attempt rather than a resolved direction.
evidence_against: With-trend case against abstaining: D1 and H4 are bull-trend (H4 window swings 2358.62 -> 2850, higher low 2633.31 above 2568.16), H4 reports 18 bars holding above 2665.14 with rising lows 2633.31/2641.37/2665.14/2705.73, so this M15 sell-off may simply be the pullback that a bull reversal bar near 2665.14-2670 would convert into a continuation long above that bar's high.

Bear case against abstaining: the failed 2717.27-2718.83 poke plus four consecutive lower M15 closes is consistent with a lower-high upthrust off the coil top, and a decisive close below 2665.14 (H1 bar 1790452800000 low) would break the H4 rising-low sequence and make the 2718.83 rejection the entry location, so NO_TRADE may forgo short follow-through.

M15 bar 119's range (7.16) is smaller than bars 117-118 (11.63 and 6.39) and its close is slightly above its own midpoint, so the down-spike is not yet accelerating; the H1 timeframe shows only one bear bar, which is thin evidence for a sustained short.
uncertainty: Whether the four-bar M15 bear sequence (bars 116-119, 2708.79 down to 2682.40) is the first leg of a break below the 2665.14 coil low or a pullback that buyers will reverse is unresolved by the supplied bars at 1790521199999.

Whether the 2717.27-2718.83 poke (M15 bars 91-94) is a final-flag upthrust below the 2850 D1 high or just a pause before an upward coil resolution cannot be settled from closed bars at the frozen time.

A close below 2665.14 with follow-through would break the H4 rising-low sequence (2633.31, 2641.37, 2665.14) and shift the read to a short from the coil's lower edge.

D1 context: bars 1790035200000-1790467199999 overlap inside 2633.31-2786.81 and the last close 2694.96 is 155.04 below the 2850 high; the new-high breakout has no follow-through, so D1 is not an independent buy signal.

uncertainty: H4 is classified trading-range while D1 is classified bull-trend; which frame governs the next leg is unresolved at 2689.

Continued bar-by-bar overlap inside roughly 2682-2694 keeps the breakout-mode range read and keeps the middle-of-range no-trade stance.

evidence_for: M15 index 102 (open_time 1790555400000, open 2691.63, high 2691.64, low 2672.54, close 2675.54) began a lower-high sequence: later M15 highs 2683.02 (index 103, 1790556300000), 2675.01 (index 105, 1790558100000) and 2660.47 (index 108, 1790560800000) all sit below the 2697.14 high of index 101 (1790554500000), so the immediate M15 pressure is down while price is only ~15 points above that leg's low 2643.44 (index 114 low, 1790566200000).

Selling location is poor: H4 context (current) has bar 119 (1790553600000-1790567999999) closing 2650.74 below the 2665.14 coil floor but above the 40-bar H4 range floor 2633.31, so a short would be entered at the lower edge of the H4 range with the 2633.31 floor only ~17-25 points away; M15 index 115 close 2650.74 confirms that close.

The long case lacks a signal bar and has immediate overhead: M15 indices 116-119 (1790568000000-1790571599999) overlap inside 2645.81-2658.6 with closes 2653.9, 2657.99, 2658.43, 2658.34 (all small bodies), and the untested resistance 2665.14 (supplied H4 tight-range floor) sits just above the 2658.6 high cluster of indices 118 (high 2658.6) and 119 (high 2658.6).

D1 context (current, always_in long, phase channel) keeps the 2358.62/2370.54/2568.16/2633.31 higher-low sequence intact with no close below 2647.9 since H4 bar 97, so 2643-2658 is a bull support zone where a weak, unaccepted M15 bear break is a poor sell and there is no completed bull reversal bar to buy.
evidence_against: Short case that could be taken: H4 context is always_in short with breakout_mode true and H4 bar 119 closed 2650.74 under the 2665.14 coil floor and under every bar 112-118 low; a sell stop below 2643.44 (M15 index 114 low, 1790566200000, low 2643.44) would be a pending breakout continuation toward 2633.31.

Long case that could be taken: M15 lows rise after 2643.44 (2645.81 index 116, 2652.05 index 117, 2655.05 index 118) and index 116 (open 2650.74, close 2653.9) closed near its high, so a buy stop above 2658.6 (index 118/119 high, 1790569800000/1790570700000) with invalidation below 2643.44 is a pending long at the low of an H4 range inside a D1 bull trend.
uncertainty: Whether the H4 break under the 2665.14 coil resolves down to the 2633.31 range floor or fails back above it (both supplied H4 transition conditions) is not settled by any bar available at the frozen time; H4 bar 119 is described as not yet accepted.
The final M15 bar (index 119, 1790570700000: open 2658.43, high 2658.6, low 2654.89, close 2658.34) is a 3.71-point inside doji, so the 4-bar micro pause is unresolved in both directions.

D1 relevance is only medium and the newest D1 bars 115-120 overlap inside 2633.31-2786.81, so the macro trend is pausing rather than accelerating; H4 always_in short carries low relevance in its own supplied context.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 close back above 2665.14 (H4 coil floor), ideally a bull bar closing near its high, would mark the H4 down-break as failed and support a long at the H4 range low with invalidation below 2643.44.
An M15 close below 2643.44 (index 114 low, 1790566200000) followed by an H4 close below 2633.31 (range floor) with follow-through would confirm the breakdown and support a short continuation.
H4 closes above 2786.81 or a D1 close back below 2557.46, per the supplied transition conditions, would shift the larger read and re-locate the trade.
