market_context.D1: Current context used: bull-trend, phase channel, always_in long; breakout leg bars 111-114 closed 2612.02-2775.61 above the 2557.46 range top; bars 115-120 are a 6-bar pause between 2633.31 (bar 117 low) and 2786.81 (bar 116 high), so 2633.31 is the higher-timeframe flag floor and also the H4 range floor.

setup.type: tight trading range at the bottom of the H4/D1 ranges; no edge entry

evidence_for: Location is crowded on both sides of the frozen price 2650.26. Downside support 2633.31 (H1 bar 28 low, H4 bar 97 low, D1 pause floor at D1 bar 117) sits only 3.71 points below the M15 tight-range low 2637.00 (M15 bar 118 low), so a short stop below 2637.00 has almost no room before the level that has held the last higher low; upside resistance 2659.27 (M15 bar 116 high) is 9.01 points above the close and the H4 tight-range floor 2665.14 is 14.88 points above, capping a long.

The last closed bar is mid-range, not an edge bar: M15 bar 119 (open 2647.65, high 2650.96, low 2647.01, close 2650.26) has a 3.95-point range and closes almost exactly on the middle of the 8-bar tight range 2637.00-2659.27 (midpoint 2648.14). Brooks' rule for a tight trading range is that the middle is not tradeable, and bars 112-119 average well under 4 points of range, i.e. breakout mode with unproven resolution.

No M15 bull signal bar has reclaimed anything: the best bull evidence is bar 118 closing at its high 2647.65 with a 10-point lower tail, but bar 119 could not close above bar 118 high or bar 116 high 2659.27, and bars 116, 117 and 118 closed 2649.60, 2647.00 and 2647.65, all below every close from M15 bar 108 (2696.19) onward. Buying needs the failed-breakout bar that does not yet exist.

The bear case is equally uncrowded at the trigger: the H4 breakout bar 119 (open 2685.9, high 2697.14, low 2643.44, close 2650.74) closed below the 2665.14 tight-range floor but short of 2633.31, and the M15 response bars 112-119 all held below 2659.27 without follow-through lower; a short at 2650.26 is inside the tight range rather than at a breakout level, so neither side offers an actionable trigger at the frozen time.
evidence_against: H4 is always_in short with breakout_mode true and M15 has made lower highs and lower lows since M15 bar 97 (high 2697.14) down to 2637.00, so one could argue a stop short below 2637.00 is the continuation of an accepted-direction breakout, with invalidation above 2659.27 (M15 bar 116 high) or above 2650.96 (M15 bar 119 high) if the tight range is treated as the flag.

The other side has a real case too: M15 bar 118 is a reversal bar at the low with a 10-point tail and a close at its high 2647.65, priced against the D1 bull-flag floor 2633.31 and the H4 range floor 2633.31, while D1 remains always_in long with the 6-bar pause holding above the 2557.46 breakout level - a buy-the-flag-floor location.

Both directional cases together are exactly why the middle is a coin flip: the same 2633.31 level is the bull's reason to buy and the bear's measured-move magnet, and the tight M15 range is only 22.27 points wide, so either trigger is a low-reward entry relative to nearby opposing structure.
uncertainty: Whether the H4 bear breakout below 2665.14 (H4 bar 119 close 2650.74) gets accepted or reverses back inside the 40-bar range - no M15 follow-through bar exists yet.
Whether the M15 tight range 2637.00-2659.27 (bars 112-119) breaks down toward 2633.31 or up through 2659.27/2665.14.
D1 bull-trend/always_in long with a pause at 2633.31 conflicts with H4 always_in short and breakout_mode, so higher-timeframe pressure is genuinely two-sided at this price.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 close back above 2665.14 (H4 tight-range floor) would identify H4 bar 119's break as failed and reopen a long toward 2697.14 (M15 bar 97 high) and 2721.75 (H4 bar 104 high).

An M15 follow-through close below 2633.31 would accept the H4 breakdown, break the H4 higher-low sequence and shift the read to a bear leg targeting lower, making shorts below 2637.00 valid rather than crowded.
A bull signal bar closing above 2659.27 (M15 bar 116 high) with a close near its high, after the 2637.00 test, would supply the missing low/second-entry bull signal at the D1 flag floor.
Continued overlapping M15 bars with closes inside 2637.00-2659.27 keep the phase a tight range and keep both triggers unattractive.

The M15 bear leg from bar 93 high 2697.14 to bar 114 low 2637 made lower highs into the pause, and H4 swing highs step down (2804.59, 2786.81, 2740.42), so a break of 2633.31 would open 2568.16 (H4 bar 73 low).
Alternatively, at the two-timeframe floor 2633.31 the bull side has a higher low 2645.34 versus 2637 with room toward 2697.14-2717.27 (M15 bars 93/96) if the floor holds.
uncertainty: Whether H4 bar 119's break below 2665.14 is a genuine bear breakout or a failed break inside the 40-bar H4 range 2633.31-2804.59; no M15 close outside 2637-2659.27 has resolved it.
H4 always_in 'short' carries relevance low in a range phase while D1 is a bull channel pause, so the higher-timeframe lean is contested.

The M15 tight range is only about 22 points (0.8%), and both nearest opposing levels (2633.31/2637 versus 2659.27/2665.14) are less than about 15 points away, so the next bar can create or invalidate any pending stop.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 bull bar closing back above 2665.14 (the broken H4 tight-range floor, H4 bars 104-118 lower boundary) would mark the downside break as failed and support a long.

Two consecutive M15 closes above 2659.27 (bar 112 high) would confirm a bull resolution of the tight range and put 2697.14 (bar 93 high) in play.
Continued M15 overlap between 2645.34 and 2659.27 keeps the read balanced/range and argues for no trade.

evidence_for: Short is at range-bottom support: M15 bar 119 (1790581500000-1790582399999) closes 2645.21, only 11.9 points above 2633.31, the floor defined by H1 bar 26 low 2633.31 (1790244000000) and H4 bar 96 low 2633.31 (1790236800000-1790251199999), and H1 bar 26 closed back up at 2647.23 after touching it - sellers would be entering into held support.

No long trigger yet: M15 bars 118 and 119 both bottom at exactly 2642.18 (opens 2642.38 / 2642.47, closes 2642.57 / 2645.21) and bar 119's range is only 5.24 points (2642.18-2647.42), a small doji/inside bar at the low rather than a bull reversal bar closing near its high, and no M15 higher low has printed.

H4 is still two-sided: H4 bars 82-118 overlap inside 2633.31-2804.59 (bar 81 high 2804.59), the last two H4 closes 2650.74 (bar 118) and 2645.21 (bar 119) are the first under the tight floor 2665.14 (H4 bar 111 low 2665.14), and H4 bar 119 low 2637 stopped short of the wider floor - an unconfirmed probe, not an accepted break.
evidence_against: Bear side is genuinely strong and is the best entry candidate: H1 bars 112-119 print lower closes 2677.74, 2656, 2650.95, 2650.74, 2658.34, 2650.26, 2647.7, 2645.21 with lower highs 2697.14 (bar 112) then 2659.27 (bar 117) then 2654.07 (bar 119), H1 bar 113 closes on its low 2656, and M15 shows a lower-high/lower-low sequence from 2718.83 down to 2642.18; a short stop below M15 low 2642.18 with invalidation at H1 bar 119 high 2654.07 was the tested alternative and was rejected only because 2633.31 sits about 9-12 points below entry.

Bull side has location but no signal: D1 is bull-trend with the six-bar pause holding above 2557.46 and H4 higher lows 2358.62 -> 2370.54 (bar 51) -> 2568.16 (bar 73) -> 2633.31 (bar 96), so buying the H4 range floor is a with-trend flag idea, but the required bull reversal bar is absent (M15 bar 119 close 2645.21 is mid-range, not a strong bull close).
uncertainty: Supplied H4 context was stale (decision_time_ms 1790567999999); it was replaced by a successful read of 120 closed H4 bars at/before 1790582399999, whose last bar (open 2650.74, high 2659.27, low 2637, close 2645.21) is the bar that closed under the tight floor 2665.14, so 'break accepted' rests on one bar plus the forming context of that read.
Whether 2633.31 (H1 bar 26 low, H4 bar 96 low, D1 pause low) breaks with follow-through or produces a bull reversal cannot be resolved from bars closed at the decision time.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 bull reversal bar closing above 2647.42 (M15 bar 119 high) after holding 2642.18 would make a long at the H4/D1 range floor actionable.

An M15 close below 2637 (H1 bar 117 low) with follow-through through 2633.31 (H1 bar 26 / H4 bar 96 low) would confirm the 40-bar H4 range break and make a short on a pullback to 2650-2665 actionable.
Continued M15 closes inside 2642.18-2654.07 keep the standoff/range read and leave Always-In relevance low in either direction.

evidence_for: Short is at range-bottom support: M15 bar 119 (1790581500000-1790582399999) closes 2645.21, only 11.9 points above 2633.31, the floor defined by H1 bar 26 low 2633.31 (1790244000000) and H4 bar 96 low 2633.31 (1790236800000-1790251199999), and H1 bar 26 closed back up at 2647.23 after touching it - sellers would be entering into held support.

No long trigger yet: M15 bars 118 and 119 both bottom at exactly 2642.18 (opens 2642.38 / 2642.47, closes 2642.57 / 2645.21) and bar 119's range is only 5.24 points (2642.18-2647.42), a small doji/inside bar at the low rather than a bull reversal bar closing near its high, and no M15 higher low has printed.

H4 is still two-sided: H4 bars 82-118 overlap inside 2633.31-2804.59 (bar 81 high 2804.59), the last two H4 closes 2650.74 (bar 118) and 2645.21 (bar 119) are the first under the tight floor 2665.14 (H4 bar 111 low 2665.14), and H4 bar 119 low 2637 stopped short of the wider floor - an unconfirmed probe, not an accepted break.
evidence_against: Bear side is genuinely strong and is the best entry candidate: H1 bars 112-119 print lower closes 2677.74, 2656, 2650.95, 2650.74, 2658.34, 2650.26, 2647.7, 2645.21 with lower highs 2697.14 (bar 112) then 2659.27 (bar 117) then 2654.07 (bar 119), H1 bar 113 closes on its low 2656, and M15 shows a lower-high/lower-low sequence from 2718.83 down to 2642.18; a short stop below M15 low 2642.18 with invalidation at H1 bar 119 high 2654.07 was the tested alternative and was rejected only because 2633.31 sits about 9-12 points below entry.

Bull side has location but no signal: D1 is bull-trend with the six-bar pause holding above 2557.46 and H4 higher lows 2358.62 -> 2370.54 (bar 51) -> 2568.16 (bar 73) -> 2633.31 (bar 96), so buying the H4 range floor is a with-trend flag idea, but the required bull reversal bar is absent (M15 bar 119 close 2645.21 is mid-range, not a strong bull close).
uncertainty: Supplied H4 context was stale (decision_time_ms 1790567999999); it was replaced by a successful read of 120 closed H4 bars at/before 1790582399999, whose last bar (open 2650.74, high 2659.27, low 2637, close 2645.21) is the bar that closed under the tight floor 2665.14, so 'break accepted' rests on one bar plus the forming context of that read.
Whether 2633.31 (H1 bar 26 low, H4 bar 96 low, D1 pause low) breaks with follow-through or produces a bull reversal cannot be resolved from bars closed at the decision time.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 bull reversal bar closing above 2647.42 (M15 bar 119 high) after holding 2642.18 would make a long at the H4/D1 range floor actionable.

An M15 close below 2637 (H1 bar 117 low) with follow-through through 2633.31 (H1 bar 26 / H4 bar 96 low) would confirm the 40-bar H4 range break and make a short on a pullback to 2650-2665 actionable.
Continued M15 closes inside 2642.18-2654.07 keep the standoff/range read and leave Always-In relevance low in either direction.

market_context.primary_regime: H4 post-climax trading range 2633.31-2804.59 inside an intact D1 bull pause
market_context.phase: tight pause: M15 micro range 2641.81-2650.82 in the lower part of the H4 range
market_context.always_in: unclear/two-sided (D1 long vs H4 short)
market_context.location: last close 2649.57 (H1 bar 119) is only ~16 points above the repeatedly bought H4 range low 2633.31

evidence_for: M15 bars 116-119 (open_time_ms 1790582400000-1790585100000) overlap inside 2641.81-2650.82 with closes 2647.99, 2644.69, 2643.91, 2649.57 and ranges of only 4.3-8.6 points: a tight trading range, not a directional leg, and no closed bar has broken it.

Long trigger is crowded: entry above M15 bar 119 high 2650.82 (open_time_ms 1790585100000) risks about 9.0 points to M15 bar 118 low 2641.81 (open_time_ms 1790584200000), while overhead supply begins at 2650.97 (M15 bar 110 high, open_time_ms 1790577000000) and 2655.24 (M15 bar 108 high, open_time_ms 1790575200000).

Short location is poor: H1 last close 2649.57 (bar 119, open_time_ms 1790582400000, high 2650.82, low 2641.81) sits only ~16 points above the H4 range low 2633.31, a level bought repeatedly in the H4 context (lows 2648.49, 2633.31, 2643.44).

The H1 leg into that zone is still down/flat: H1 bar 112 (open_time_ms 1790557200000) is a wide bear bar closing at its low 2656.00, and H1 bar 116 (open_time_ms 1790571600000) printed the 2637.00 low, so a long fires against fresh H1 pressure with the H4 range low still untested.
evidence_against: Long case: D1 context is bull-trend with a six-bar pause holding above 2557.46 and the 2633.31 higher low unbroken; M15 bar 119 (open 2643.89, high 2650.82, low 2642.22, close 2649.57) is a bull bar closing near its high after the 2637.00 low of M15 bar 106 (open_time_ms 1790573400000), with flat micro lows 2641.81/2642.18/2642.22 forming a small double bottom at the lower edge of the H4 range.

Short case: H4 context is trading-range/always-in short with the last two H4 bars bear and closing near their lows on expanded volume; M15 bars 113-118 (open_time_ms 1790579700000-1790584200000) close 2642.51, 2642.57, 2645.21, 2644.69, 2643.91, holding the lower half of the micro range, so a stop under 2641.81 targets the untested 2633.31 magnet.
uncertainty: Whether the 2641.81-2650.82 M15 tight range is a bear flag toward the 2633.31 H4 range low or a bottoming range at that low is unresolved by closed bars; neither side has shown breakout follow-through.
D1 (bull pause, always-in long) and H4 (trading range, always-in short) contexts disagree, so higher-timeframe location is two-sided rather than a single directional edge.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 close above 2659.27 (bar 104 high, open_time_ms 1790571600000) with a large bull body would put price back above the six-bar range and make a long at the H4 range low actionable.
Two consecutive M15 closes below 2641.81 with expanding range would confirm the tight range as a bear flag and make the 2633.31 H4 range-low test the next short location.
A fast recovery back above 2665.14 (H4 coil low) after any break of 2641.81 would mark a failed break and restore the two-sided read.

market_context.regime_read: Two-sided: D1 context is a bull-trend pause (six overlapping bars holding above the 2557.46 range top, higher lows 2358.62/2436.87/2604.75/2633.31); H4 context (current) is a post-climax trading range 2636.28-2740.42 with contracting ranges and two-sided bars after the 2850 buying-climax bar; H1 is chop between 2636.28 (H1 bar 107 low) and 2709.21 (H1 bar 115 high).
market_context.location: Last M15 close 2673.06 sits near the middle of the H4 range 2636.28-2740.42 (midpoint ~2688) and near the middle of the H1 swing band; just below are repeated H4 lows 2636-2648, just above are rejected highs 2709.21/2718.83/2740.42.
market_context.phase: Tight M15 trading range (bars 112-119) inside a larger H4 range.

evidence_for: M15 bar 119 (open_time_ms 1790631900000: open 2679.7, high 2679.81, low 2673.06, close 2673.06) is a bear bar closing on its low, but its entire 6.75-point range is contained inside the prior M15 tight range bounded by 2688.3 (bar 116 high) and 2667.7 (bar 110 low); no M15 range edge was broken at the frozen time.

M15 bars 112-118 overlap with tiny ranges and alternating closes (2684.63, 2679.47, 2679.2, 2681.96, 2685.33, 2680.9, 2679.7), i.e. a tight two-sided range - the Brooks condition for standing aside rather than entering.

Location is mid-range on both larger scales: 2673.06 versus H4 range 2636.28-2740.42 (mid ~2688) and versus H1 2636.28 (H1 bar 107 low) to 2709.21 (H1 bar 115 high); neither the top nor the bottom edge is available for an edge entry.

The bear leg already delivered from 2698.46 (M15 bar 108 high) to 2667.7 (M15 bar 110 low), so a fresh short at 2673.06 has only about 5.4 points to that low and the repeatedly tested H4 support zone 2636-2648 immediately below, crowding the short's reward against its invalidation.

H1 bar 118 (open_time_ms 1790625600000: open 2672.79, high 2684.63, close 2681.96) closed at its high, and H1 bar 119 (open_time_ms 1790629200000: open 2681.96, high 2688.3, low 2673.06, close 2673.06) holds a low above H1 bar 117's low 2667.7, so there is no H1 lower low or downside follow-through to confirm a short.

H4 context reports contracting bar ranges (7.68, 13.86 points) with highs stepping down (2709.21, 2718.83, 2740.42) and lows holding 2636-2648 - a coiled, balanced range where an entry inside the range has no edge.
evidence_against: The final M15 bar 119 is a bear bar closing at its low after a lower high (2688.3 on M15 bar 116 vs 2698.46 on M15 bar 108), which can be read as a Low 2-style short with a pending stop below 2673.06 and structural invalidation above 2688.3, about 15 points of risk.

The D1 context is still bull-trend with rising lows and acceptance above the 2557.46 breakout level, so a long attempt from the lower half of the H4 range toward 2709-2740 is arguable if 2667.7 holds, and 2673.06 is in the lower half of the H4 range.
H4 is in breakout mode with shrinking ranges, so a decisive break of 2636.28 or 2740.42 could produce a large directional move that abstaining now would miss.
M15 bar 112 (open_time_ms 1790625600000: open 2672.79, high 2684.63, close 2684.63) closed at its high off the 2667.7 low, showing buyers still respond at the lower edge of the micro range.
uncertainty: The exact H4 range boundaries (2636.28-2740.42) come from the supplied H4 context description; raw H4 bars were not re-read because the context is tagged current.
Whether the M15 tight range (2667.7-2688.3) resolves up or down is unknown at the frozen time; the last bar closes on its low but remains inside the range.
Supplied volume was treated as optional and was not used as evidence; its absence or form does not affect this read.
D1/H4 structures overlap (a 24-bar D1 range, a six-bar D1 pause, an H4 range and an H4 mtr-like shape), so the higher-timeframe classification is mixed rather than cleanly trending.

setup.type: M15 bull micro-channel / spike up into H4 range-top resistance (candidate long, rejected on location)

evidence_for: Location: the candidate long is at the upper edge of the H4 two-sided range. M15 bar 119 (open_time 1790664300000) closed 2703.02 with high 2705.57, inside the H4 top zone 2695-2740.42 and in the upper part of the 11-bar coil 2636.28-2718.83, where H4 highs 2699.39/2699.53/2709.21 were repeatedly rejected; buying the top edge of a range is not a favorable long location.

Immediate opposing structure crowds the setup: M15 bar 64 high 2706.07 and bar 65 high 2709.21 remain unbroken, and bar 119 high 2705.57 stalled just under them (about 4 points), while the structural invalidation of the spike (M15 bar 114 low 2655.54, open_time 1790659800000) is about 50 points below the last close; a long here buys into resistance with the stop far beneath it.

The long is late: M15 bars 116-119 (closes 2689.93, 2693.37, 2697.5, 2703.02) are the fourth consecutive bull bar after the spike began at bar 114 low 2655.54, i.e. an extended micro-channel entered into overhead supply rather than at the start of the leg.

Higher-timeframe structure is not yet broken: H1 still shows lower highs at 2718.83 (H1 bar 73) and 2709.21 (H1 bar 106), and the last H1 bar 119 (open 2674.82, high 2705.57, close 2703.02) has not exceeded 2709.21; the H4 coil top 2718.83 also remains untested.

D1 context itself flags the risk: 162 points below the 2850 high, with the most recent D1 bars small overlapping dojis between 2636.28 and 2740.42 and no trend bar after the 2850 high, a shape that fits a final flag at the trend extreme rather than confirmed resumption.

The opposite direction is also unattractive: shorting the four-bar bull micro-channel (M15 bars 116-119) would be counter to the D1 always-in long / bull-trend read, so neither edge offers an acceptable equation at this location.
evidence_against: Strongest counterargument to NO_TRADE: M15 bars 116-119 are a clean four-bar bull spike with higher highs and lows and closes near the highs (bar 119 close 2703.02 versus high 2705.57, about 81% of its range), and the sequence cleared the prior M15 congestion at 2695.95/2698.46 (bars near 1790613000000-1790622000000) - a pending stop above 2705.57 or 2709.21 with a stop under 2655.54 would be the standard Brooks spike-continuation entry.

The spike began from a higher low (M15 bar 102 low 2652.27, bar 114 low 2655.54) that held above the H4 coil low 2636.28 and above the H4 bull-leg midpoint 2604.31, which reads as a bull flag above support rather than a failed rally; the H4 context's own counter-case says the flag read would make this a continuation pause.

D1 is a bull trend, always_in long, breakout_mode: buying with the higher-timeframe trend is the aligned direction, and a break of 2709.21 would put the H4 coil top 2718.83 and the range top 2740.42 in play as the first continuation levels.
uncertainty: Whether the H4 coil 2636.28-2718.83 resolves upward as a bull flag or is the last rotation under the 2850 high (final flag) is unresolved in the supplied bars.
Whether the four M15 bull bars are the first leg of a range breakout or the last leg into the range top; the M15 high 2709.21 is untested and untriggered.
The H4 range boundaries are zones rather than exact prices (top rejected anywhere from 2695 to 2740.42, bottom 2633.31-2650.74), so the exact 'edge' location is approximate.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 close above 2709.21 (M15 bar 65 high) with follow-through, and preferably an H4 close above 2718.83 and then 2740.42, would support a breakout long entry with the D1 bull trend.
A pullback that holds above 2655.54 (M15 bar 114 low) and forms a High 1 / High 2 buy setup would offer a much better long location than the current range-top close.
An M15/H1 close below 2636.28 and 2633.31 would invalidate the bull-flag read, end the coil's two-sided behavior and shift the read toward a bear leg or range expansion downward.
Failure of H1 to exceed 2709.21 while M15 bars overlap and stall under 2706-2709 would keep the range/breakout-mode read and continue to favor waiting over entering.

market_context.h4_context_freshness: stale at 1790654399999; read replaced by 120 raw closed H4 bars, whose last bar (1790654400000-1790668799999) is a bull bar open 2663.59 / low 2655.54 / high 2717.28 / close 2710.21 but still inside the range

setup.type: bull micro-channel pressing the top of a two-week trading range; breakout level 2718.83 not yet cleared

evidence_for: Location: M15 bar 119 (open_time 1790667900000) closed 2710.21, about 90% up the H4/H1 coil 2636.28-2718.83 and about 72% up the two-week H4 range 2633.31-2740.42 (H4 range low 2633.31 at 1790236800000; range high 2740.42 at 1790323200000), so a long here buys the range's top edge rather than a dip.

Opposing structure crowds the trade: H1 bar 72 (1790496000000) high 2718.83 and H1 bar 28 (1790337600000) high 2721.75 are only 8.6 and 11.5 points above the last M15 close 2710.21, with H1 bar 27 (1790334000000) high 2740.42 next; a breakout stop at the coil high 2718.83 risks ~19 points to the M15 bar 116 (1790665200000) low 2699.67 for only ~22 points to the first meaningful resistance, so the Trader's Equation is thin.

The M15 leg is already extended and has stalled at that resistance: M15 bars 111-117 (1790660700000 to 1790666100000) are seven consecutive bull bars closing 2674.82 up to 2712.89 off the 2655.54 low (bar 110), and the final two bars are small bear bars (bar 118 high 2717.28, close 2712.02; bar 119 high 2712.58, close 2710.21) at the M15 window high, so there is no fresh bull signal bar and no breakout confirmation.

No new H1 high close: H1 bar 119 (1790665200000) closed 2710.21 with a 7.07-point upper tail, below the recent H1 high closes 2713.46 (bar 72) and 2717.13 (bar 28) and below the coil high 2718.83, so H1 is back inside its range top rather than through it.

D1 context (current) is a bull trend, but its last seven bars are a tight 2636.28-2740.42 doji cluster under the 2850 high with the 1790121600000 bar closing 2684.16 below its open; the always-in-long label is a lean, and no D1 boundary resolution exists to justify buying at the range top.
evidence_against: D1 (current context): primary_regime bull-trend, always_in long, breakout_mode true, with higher swing lows 2436.87 and 2633.31 and a four-bar range breakout closing 2612.02, 2632.98, 2642.9, 2775.61 near the highs.

H1 bar 118 (1790661600000) is a strong bull trend bar: open 2674.82, high 2705.57, low 2674.75, close 2703.02, with the close in the top 3% of its range, and H1 bar 119 followed through to 2717.28, breaking the prior H1 high 2709.21 (bar 63, 1790614800000).

M15 bars 111-117 form a tight bull micro-channel with rising pullback lows (2663.87, 2699.67, 2707.51), so the M15 always-in is long; a buy stop above the H1/H4 coil high 2718.83 is a standard Brooks breakout entry that could resolve the coil toward 2740.42 and then 2786.81.
The raw H4 read supports the bull-flag case: the 2358.62-2850 leg's pullback stopped at 2633.31, above the leg midpoint 2604.31, and no bar has closed below the 2612.02 breakout close.
uncertainty: Whether the coil above 2718.83 breaks with follow-through or fails back through 2699.67 is unresolved at the decision time; the pending breakout is untriggered, not failed.
The H4 top is a zone (2695 to 2740.42), not a single price, so 'range top' carries about 45 points of slack and the current bars sit at its lower half.
The supplied H4 context was stale (1790654399999); the last H4 bar added by the raw read is a strong bull bar that the stale context did not contain.
Volume was not used and no indicator or order-flow data was supplied, so the location judgement rests on bar geometry alone.
conditions_that_change_market_read: An M15 or H1 close above 2718.83 and then 2740.42 with consecutive bull trend bars closing at their highs would mark a real coil breakout; a subsequent pullback holding above 2718.83 would then be the long.
A pullback holding above 2699.67 or 2674.75 that forms a bull reversal bar or a higher low inside the range would give a long with nearby structural support instead of a top-edge entry.

A bear bar closing below 2699.67 followed by a close below 2674.75 would break the M15 micro-channel and the H1 breakout bar low, making a short against this range top with a stop above 2717.28 the actionable setup.
A close below 2636.28 and 2633.31 would confirm the H4 range breaking down, with 2612.02 and 2604.31 as the next structural references.

market_context.summary: D1 bull trend (always_in long) but in breakout-mode tight 7-bar cluster under the 2850 climax high; H4 is a 35-bar trading range 2633.31-2740.42 with stepped-down highs from 2850; H1/M15 show a bull recovery leg back into the upper quarter of that H4 range, into a two-touch 2717.27/2717.28 resistance with a 2726.68 spike already rejected.
market_context.H4_regime: trading-range 2633.31-2740.42 (context current; raw H4 re-read 48 closed bars)
market_context.D1_regime: bull-trend channel, breakout_mode true, tight range 2636.28-2740.42 under the 2850 high
market_context.H1_regime: upper half of the same range; last bar i=119 bull close 2716.81 near high 2719.55
market_context.bar_index_base: M15 and H1 indices are zero-based within the supplied 120-bar windows; M15 window starts at open_time_ms 1790568000000, H1 window at 1790244000000

evidence_for: Location: the last M15 bar (i=119, 1790675100000-1790675999999, o 2710.69 h 2719.55 l 2710.53 c 2716.81) closes 78% up the H4 35-bar range 2633.31-2740.42, i.e. inside the top quarter and directly beneath the 2740.42 range top; a long here buys range resistance, not a range edge discount.

Resistance is already tested twice: H4 high 2717.28 (bar 1790654400000-1790668799999, h 2717.28 c 2710.21) equals the prior H4 high 2717.27 (bar 1790481600000-1790495999999), and M15 i=113-114 spiked to 2726.68 then reversed to close at its low 2710.12 (i=114 o 2721.94 h 2726.68 l 2710.12 c 2710.12), rejecting that test.
No bear trigger either: M15 i=118 (o 2703.98 h 2710.95 c 2710.69) and i=119 close in the upper part of their ranges, so a short would be selling below bull bars with no reversal bar at the level.

Higher-timeframe supply confirmed: D1 2850 high carries a 126.85 upper tail with no follow-through and the last four D1 bars trade 2636.28-2740.42 (same band as the H4 range); H4 context records retraced climax bars 1789128000000 and 1789977600000 (tails 124.48 and 126.85) and stepped-down highs 2804.59, 2786.81, 2740.42, 2717.28.
Range mid/no-trade zone: 35 H4 bars overlap inside 2633.31-2740.42 with no accepted closing break of either edge, so neither edge trade is confirmed and the middle of the range offers no edge.
evidence_against: Strongest case for a long: M15 i=102 low 2655.54 to i=113 high 2726.68 is a bull leg of consecutive bull closes (i=104 c 2689.93, i=107 c 2703.02, i=110 h 2717.28, i=113 c 2720.57); the pullback to i=117 low 2702.09 is only ~35% of that leg, holds above i=108 low 2699.67, and i=118/i=119 then close near their highs, giving a bull pullback buy (stop above 2719.55, invalidation below 2702.09).

Higher-timeframe lean is still long: D1 always_in long (medium relevance) with higher swing lows 2357.18/2436.87/2633.31, H4 always_in long, and H4's last bar closes at 88.6% of its range after a higher low at 2636.28 (1790582400000); H4 transition conditions name a close above 2740.42 as the bull breakout, so the range may resolve upward.
uncertainty: M15 raw window covers only 1790568000000-1790675999999 (120 bars, ~30 hours), so M15 structure before 2655.54 is not supplied.

The 2726.68-to-2702.09 drop can be counted either as a completed bull-flag pullback (bull continuation) or as the second rejection of 2717-2727 (range-top fade); the distinction is not settled by the closed bars.
The current H4 bar (open 1790668800000, open price 2709.26, so far high 2726.68, current 2716.81) is not closed at the decision time, so its final body/tail shape is unknown.
H4 context and the 48 closed raw H4 bars I read agree on the 2633.31-2740.42 range, but the range edges are behaviourally soft (1790150400000 high 2748.23 exceeded 2740.42 intrabar).
conditions_that_change_market_read: M15 bars closing above 2726.68 and then above 2740.42 with a higher low would turn this into a range-breakout long (buy the breakout or its pullback), changing entry_mechanism to breakout/breakout_pullback.
A bear reversal bar at 2716-2727 closing below 2710.53 (M15 i=119 low) with follow-through below 2702.09 would create a valid range-top short with invalidation above the reversal bar's high.
A close below 2633.31 (H4 range low) with follow-through would confirm the downside break of the 35-bar range and shift the read toward the lower edge/short side.
Continued overlapping bars contained between about 2702 and 2726 with no boundary close keeps the current balanced range read and favors waiting.

H4 context shows ascending lows inside the range (2633.31 bar 89, 2637 bar 112, 2643.44 bar 111, 2652.27 bar 117) and M15 low 2669.96 is a higher low above 2652.27, so the break may only probe a support shelf; M15 bar 119 is a small bull bar closing at its high (2674.78 of 2670.06-2674.80), a weak short signal bar.
The H4 is a 46-bar trading range whose edges have failed to hold (2804.59 to 2648.49; 2633.31 back to 2694.09), so a break of the M15 flag can remain a range-bound probe rather than a trend leg.
uncertainty: Continuation depends on the pending stop: if 2670.06 is not breached, or price closes back above 2682.33, the Low 2 setup is void.
Whether the H4 range low 2633.31 and the ascending H4 lows absorb the break, turning it into a bear trap that reverses up for a test of 2694-2742.
The flag is only 12 points tall with heavy overlap, so the first breakout attempt can fail before follow-through.
conditions_that_change_market_read: A close above 2682.33 (M15 bar 118 high) voids the bear flag and shifts the read to a bull flag/higher-low test of 2702-2714.
A close below 2669.96 with follow-through below 2652.27 confirms the M15 bear breakout of the higher-low series toward the H4 range low 2633.31.
Two consecutive H4 closes below 2633.31 shift the H4 from trading-range to bear-breakout per the H4 transition conditions.
Continued overlapping closes between 2670 and 2682 keeps the tight-range/unclear read and removes the Low 2 edge.
